## 来自北电网络的教训

<!--en-->
*Lessons from Nortel*

北电网络在2001–2002年的亏损期间采用了一种由来已久（尽管并不光彩）的策略：进行“大洗澡”式会计处理。夸大亏损可以创造出所谓的“蓄水池式准备金”，以便日后转为利润。这种策略的前提是：夸大年度亏损对股价的影响，不如在随后年度夸大年度利润对股价的促进作用那么大。

<!--en-->
Nortel followed a time-honored (albeit not honorable) strategy of taking a big bath in its money-losing period of 2001–2002. Overstating losses created cookie-jar reserves that could be taken into profits later years. The big bath strategy is premised on the belief that magnifying an annual loss will not hurt the stock price as much as magnifying an annual profit will help it in a subsequent year.

在北电网络案例中，或许更为重要的是这种处理方式对基于盈利恢复而发放的奖金的影响。早在2003年针对高管的新计划出台之前，大多数北电网络员工就适用这种安排。在这种机制下，即便通过不合理的应计项目人为抬高了报告亏损额，当前的奖金也不会因此降为零；但如果这些应计项目在随后的盈利年度被转为利润，未来的奖金反而会随之增加。

<!--en-->
Perhaps even more important in Nortel's case was the impact on bonuses that were paid as a function of returning to profitability. This was the arrangement for most Nortel employees even before the new plan for senior executives was adopted in 2003. In this sort of scheme, current bonuses are not reduced from zero if a reported loss is pumped up through unjustified accruals, but future bonuses are increased if those accruals are taken into profits later on, in a profitable year.

基于以往“大洗澡”和“蓄水池式准备金”的先例，投资者对2003年10月发布的财务重述公告反应平淡——该公告声称重述后此前的亏损额有所减少——这种反应可谓天真。北电网络的经历表明：如果一家公司利用应计项目来压低利润，它绝不会介意通过激进的收入确认方式来虚增利润。

<!--en-->
Based on past examples of big baths and cookie jar reserves, investors' muted reaction to the October 2003 announcement of a restatement, on the grounds that it lowered previously reported losses, was naive. Nortel's experience shows that if a company uses accruals to understate profits, it will have no compunction about overstating profits through aggressive revenue recognition.

2003年的公告非但没有平息事态，反而成了情况日益恶化的开端。

<!--en-->
Instead of blowing over, the 2003 announcement proved to be the beginning of a situation that kept getting worse and worse.

北电网络滥用的应计项目源自合同负债。例如，假设该公司未能按时履行一份价值500万美元的合同，并合理估计此举将导致50万美元的客户退款损失。这笔预期退款金额会被记为费用，从而减少当年利润，并在支付前作为负债记录在账。如果客户后来只接受30万美元的退款，剩余的20万美元就会在退款支付当期被确认为利润。北电网络董事会的调查发现，2003年管理层擅自动用这些“蓄水池”中的准备金，且并无正当理由；此外，管理层还夸大了准备金数额，以制造更大的“蓄水池”供其随意支取。

<!--en-->
The accruals that Nortel abused arose from contractual liabilities. For example, suppose the company missed a deadline on a $5 million contract and reasonably estimated the failure would cost it $500,000 through a customer refund. The amount of the expected refund would be booked as an expense, reducing current-year profits, and would be recorded as a liability until it was paid. If the customer subsequently agreed to accept a refund of only $300,000, the remaining $200,000 would be recognized as a profit in the period in which the refund was paid. The investigation by Nortel's board found that in 2003 management raided the cookie jar, taking reserves off its balance sheet without legitimate triggers for doing so. Furthermore, management overstated the reserves to create a bigger cookie jar into which it could dip.

滥用应计项目的行为已深深植根于北电网络的企业文化中。高管们用“硬度”一词来形容拥有充足准备金可供日后调节利润的状态。《华尔街日报》获得了一份公司内部文件，其中显示了季度盈利目标。

<!--en-->
Abuse of accruals was deeply embedded in Nortel's culture. Executives used the term *hardness* to describe the state of having ample reserves in place to draw on later as a means of managing earnings. The *Wall Street Journal* got access to an internal company document showing quarterlyearnings targets.

2003年上半年，利润线持续上升，同时标记为*资产负债表*的另一项数据也在不断变化，这表明管理层是通过动用储备金来推高盈利的。⁹ 深入剖析利润问题

<!--en-->
During the first half of 2003, the profit line kept rising as another number labeled *balance sheet* also kept changing, suggesting that management was generating the earnings increases by drawing on reserves.⁹
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

出于计算奖金等内部目的，北电网络使用了一种被称为“备考利润”的数据。该公司最初对外公布的2003年第一季度净利润为5400万美元。然而根据董事会的调查，内部数据中包含约3.61亿美元的储备金，其中约1.6亿美元被不当冲回。第二季度，北电网络对外公布的亏损额为1400万美元，但备考利润却达到3400万美元；一旦累计四个季度的利润达标，大多数员工可获发相当于年薪10%至25%的奖金，高层管理人员则可获得2至4倍年薪的奖金。最终，由于董事会要求管理层清理多年来因储备金会计处理方式混乱而造成的账目问题，这一骗局才得以揭穿。

<!--en-->
For internal purposes that included calculation of bonuses, Nortel used a figure it called “pro forma income.” Its initial, publicly reported net income for the first quarter of 2003 was $54 million. The internal figure, on the other hand, included approximately $361 million in reserves, of which roughly $160 million was inappropriately reversed, according to the board’s investigation. In the second quarter, Nortel publicly reported a $14 million loss, but the pro forma profit was $34 million, triggering bonuses of 10 to 25 percent of annual salary for most employees and two to four times salary for top managers, once four quarters of cumulative profits were recorded. Ultimately, the scheme unraveled when the board ordered management to clean up the company’s balance after years of accumulated reserve accounting that gave rise to confusion.

从北电网络的案例中可以得出一个重要启示：看似微不足道的项目往往具有重大意义。在2000年至2004年间总计340亿美元的损失中，投资者对几亿美元规模的储备金相关损失并未给予足够重视。

<!--en-->
An important takeaway from the Nortel case is that seemingly small items can prove highly significant. Investors paid little attention to a few hundred million dollars of reserve-related losses in the context of a total of $34 billion of losses recorded from 2000 to 2004.

这些储备金的追加使得应计负债在2002年夏季增长至50亿美元，从而为管理层操纵盈利、以获取更多奖金提供了巨大空间。

<!--en-->
Those additions to reserves, however, added to accrued liabilities that grew to $5 billion by the summer of 2002, giving management a vast opportunity to manipulate earnings to enhance its bonuses.

### 通用汽车对盈利的刻意追求

<!--en-->
*GRASPING FOR EARNINGS AT GENERAL MOTORS*

返利是另一个常被滥用的费用确认手段。通用汽车在此方面的操作凸显了企业文化对财务报告诚信度的重要影响。许多财务报表使用者更为熟悉的企业文化问题是：许多股价飙升的年轻、快速增长型企业往往对公认会计原则（GAAP）的细节持随意态度。不过，选择蓝筹股公司并不保证其账目绝对干净。一家历史悠久、资产负债表稳健且盈利记录稳定的公司，或许原本有着严格遵循会计准则的企业文化，但一旦盈利能力开始下滑，这种文化也可能随之改变。

<!--en-->
Rebates are another frequently abused element of expense recognition. General Motors’s fiddling with this device shows the important role of corporate culture in the integrity of financial reporting. The corporate culture problem more familiar to many users of financial statements is the casual attitude toward the niceties of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) that characterizes many young, fast-growing companies with soaring stock prices. Sticking with blue chips, however, is no guarantee that the books are immaculate. A long-established company with a strong balance sheet and a lengthy record of stable earnings may have a corporate culture that includes going by the book on accounting matters, but that culture may change if profitability starts to erode.

2000年代初，随着经营状况恶化，通用汽车（GM）便体现了这种病态现象。¹⁰ 在其作为全球最大汽车制造商的长期统治期间，通用汽车具备所有蓝筹股的特征。1953年首次被穆迪和标准普尔评级时，该公司便获得了最高的AAA级评级。在鼎盛时期，通用汽车非但没有在财务报告上偷工减料，反而超前于1933年《证券法》的要求，主动向投资者提供经审计的财务报表。

<!--en-->
General Motors (GM) illustrated this pathology as its fortunes deteriorated in the early 2000s.¹⁰ During its long reign as the world’s largest automaker, GM displayed all the insignia of a blue chip. When it was first rated by Moody’s and Standard & Poor’s in 1953, the company achieved the top ranking of Triple-A. Far from cutting corners in its financial reporting,GM in its heyday exceeded the requirements, providing investors audited financial statements before it became mandatory under the Securities Act of 1933.

费用确认 155

<!--en-->
Expense Recognition
155

然而随着时间的推移，通用汽车失去了在汽车行业的主导地位。部分原因是外国制造商顺应消费者偏好的变化抢占了市场份额，而美国本土厂商通用、福特和克莱斯勒对此反应迟缓。到1981年，通用汽车的AAA评级已不复存在，其对财务报告的态度也开始转变。1982年，该公司放宽了一些政策，并很快成为财务会计准则委员会听证会上主张放宽会计标准的常客。

<!--en-->
Over time, however, GM lost its commanding position in the auto industry. This was partly because foreign manufacturers captured market share by catering to changes in consumer preferences to which U.S. producers GM, Ford, and Chrysler were slow to respond. By 1981, GM's Triple-A ratings were gone, and its attitude toward financial reporting began to shift. The company liberalized some of its policies in 1982 and soon became a regular proponent of looser accounting standards at hearings of the Financial Accounting Standards Board.

到2005年，通用汽车的债券评级已跌至投机级别，仅为BB级。同年，有迹象表明激进的财务报告方式已深植于通用汽车的企业文化中。2005年10月26日，该公司披露美国证券交易委员会正在调查其会计处理的多个方面。此次调查涉及传票，内容涵盖退休福利会计处理、与德尔福公司（一家曾为通用子公司后破产的供应商）之间的某些交易，以及从供应商处收回召回成本的处理方式。

<!--en-->
By 2005, GM's bond ratings had slid all the way to the speculative grade category, at Double-B. In the same year, disturbing signs began to surface that an aggressive approach to financial reporting had become embedded in GM's corporate culture. On October 26, 2005, the company disclosed that the Securities and Exchange Commission was investigating various aspects of its accounting. The probe, replete with subpoenas, addressed accounting for retirement benefits; certain transactions with Delphi, a bankrupt supplier that was formerly a division of GM; and the treatment of recovery of recall costs from suppliers.

2005年11月9日，通用汽车宣布将重新编制2001年及可能随后几年的财务结果。

<!--en-->
On November 9, 2005, GM announced that it would have to restate its financial results for 2001 and possibly for subsequent years.

该公司称自己“错误地”记录了来自供应商的贷项，导致2001年利润被高估3亿至4亿美元。¹¹ 这一数字占该汽车制造商2001年年报中最初公布的6.01亿美元净利润的很大一部分。该数值较2000年的44.5亿美元有所下降，反映出通用汽车所面临的巨大盈利压力。

<!--en-->
The company said it had “erroneously” booked credits from suppliers, resulting in an overstatement of 2001 income by $300 million to $400 million.¹¹ That represented a hefty chunk of the $601 million in net income that the automaker originally showed in its 2001 annual report. The figure was down from $4.45 billion in 2000, underscoring the intense earnings pressure that GM was feeling.

通用汽车重新编制财务报表的核心问题在于供应商返利及其他信贷的会计处理。根据会计准则，如果返利不仅涉及当期业务，而是作为提前激励以促成数年内的大额订单，那么这些返利应分期计入损益，而非立即入账。2005年3月，首席财务官约翰·德瓦恩曾声称通用汽车“非常明确”的政策是不接受供应商的返利。然而，在宣布即将重新编制报表时，发言人托妮·西蒙内蒂却收回了这一说法。“我可以说，几年前我们确实表示会停止这种做法，实际上我们也基本做到了，”她解释道，“但我不确定这种做法是否已被完全杜绝。”¹²从美国证监会调查所涉及的多种会计做法来看，不当处理返利并非孤立事件，而是通用汽车财务报告中存在普遍激进会计行为的体现。

<!--en-->
At issue in GM's restatement was the recording of rebates and other credits from suppliers. The accounting rules stated that if the rebates involved not only current business but were upfront inducements to place large orders over several years, they should be taken into earnings over time, rather than booked immediately. In March 2005, Chief Financial Officer John Devine had stated that GM's “very clear” policy was to take no rebates from suppliers. In conjunction with the announcement of a coming restatement, however, spokeswoman Toni Simonetti backtracked on that claim. “I will say that some years ago we did say that we would generally discontinue this practice and generally we have,” she explained. “I'm not sure if it's been stopped completely across the board.”¹²
Judging by the range of accounting practices that the SEC was looking into, it appeared that the inappropriate handling of rebates was not an isolated incident, but symptomatic of widespread aggressiveness in GM'sreporting.

在2005年11月9日宣布重新编制报表的同时，该公司披露称其已评估了用于判断资产是否应被认定为减值并予注销的控制措施与程序的有效性。董事长里克·瓦格纳表示，他与首席财务官德瓦恩认为，该公司的控制措施未能达到美国证监会所定义的“合理保证水平”。结果导致通用汽车未能及时调低其对斯巴鲁汽车制造商富士重工投资的账面价值。更深入地审视利润情况……

<!--en-->
Coincident with its November 9, 2005, restatement announcement, the company disclosed that it had evaluated the effectiveness of its controls and procedures for determining whether assets should be deemed impaired and written off. Chairman Rick Wagoner said that he and CFO Devine had concluded that the company's controls were not effective at the SEC-defined "reasonable assurance level." As a result, GM had failed to reduce the value of its investment in Fuji Heavy Industries, the producer of Subaru cars, in a timely manner.
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

2006年3月16日，通用汽车财务报告的可信度再次受到打击。该公司称，其抵押贷款子公司产生的部分现金流本应归类为投资活动，却被错误地记入经营活动。这一发现令会计专家感到困惑，因为相关规则十分明确：发放贷款或收回还款属于投资活动；利息支付则计入经营活动现金流。很难想象这种错误是如何产生的。

<!--en-->
Yet another blow to the credibility of GM's financial reporting arrived on March 16, 2006. The company said that some cash flows from its mortgage subsidiary that should have been classified among its investing activities were instead booked as operating activities. This revelation puzzled accounting experts because the applicable rules were unambiguous. Extending a loan or receiving repayment fell into investing activities; interest payments were included in operating cash flow. It was difficult to see how an error could arise.

同样令人担忧的是，通用汽车透露其在2000年将库存贵金属出售所产生的2700万美元收益计入账目，尽管该公司当时已约定次年回购这些金属。

<!--en-->
Similarly troubling was GM's revelation that in 2000 it booked a $27 million gain on the sale of precious metals in its inventory, even though it had agreed to repurchase the metals the following year.

根据回购协议，该交易实质属于融资行为而非销售行为，因此公司本不应确认任何收入。违反如此基本的会计原则似乎并非无心之失；相反，这更像是为了制造账面盈利而精心策划的交易，目的是让这家急于显得盈利的公司看起来更加光鲜。

<!--en-->
The repurchase agreement made the transaction a financing, rather than a sale, so the company should have recorded no income. Running afoul of such a fundamental accounting principle did not sound like an honest mistake. Rather, it had the scent of a transaction concocted for no economic purpose but rather to generate reported earnings at a company desperate to appear profitable.

进一步调查显示，通用汽车的激进会计行为并未止步于2000–2001年。该公司告知投资者，其在2005年第一季度少报了1.49亿美元的亏损。管理层称，他们过早地提高了租赁给租车公司的车辆估值，理由是假设这些车辆在租期结束后仍具有较高价值。

<!--en-->
It further developed that GM's aggressive accounting had not ended in 2000–2001. The company told investors that it had understated its loss in 2005's first quarter by $149 million. Management said it had prematurely increased the value of vehicles it was leasing to car-rental companies, assuming they would be worth more after those companies were through with them.

在最新披露的会计相关问题之后，通用汽车推迟向美国证监会提交10-K年度报告，这通常是财务困境的典型征兆。另一个类似迹象出现在2005年12月，当时公司突然更换高层管理人员：首席财务官约翰·德瓦恩被弗雷德里克·“弗里茨”·亨德森取代，后者后来接替瓦格纳成为首席执行官。

<!--en-->
In the wake of the latest accounting-related disclosures, GM delayed the filing of its 10-K annual report to the SEC, a classic warning sign of financial distress. Another such indication had already come in December 2005 with an abrupt senior management change. Chief Financial Officer John Devine was replaced by Frederick "Fritz" Henderson, who later succeeded Wagoner as chief executive officer.

这些明显的迹象并非虚惊一场。

<!--en-->
These telltale events did not turn out to be false warnings.

2009年6月1日，通用汽车申请破产。此时，该公司股价已从2005年底的19.42美元暴跌至0.75美元。即便在2005–2006年，许多投资者仍难以想象一家曾被视作蓝筹股典范的公司会申请破产。然而对于关注财务报告的人士而言，这一结果并非不可预见。越来越多的证据表明，通用汽车存在激进会计行为，这反映出其企业文化正在恶化，同时其创造真实盈利的能力也在减弱。费用确认 157

<!--en-->
On June 1, 2009, General Motors filed for bankruptcy. By then, the company's stock price had plummeted to $0.75 from its year-end 2005 level of $19.42. Even as late as 2005–2006, many investors found it hard to imagine a bankruptcyfiling by a company once regarded as the bluest of blue chips. To close watchers of financial reporting, however, that outcome was by no means inconceivable. The mounting evidence of aggressive accounting strongly suggested that GM's corporate culture was deteriorating as its ability to generate bona fide profits waned.

157

### 房地美的时间错配问题

<!--en-->
*TIME-SHIFTING AT FREDDIE MAC*

通常而言，当公司公布的盈利意外增加时，其股价也会随之上涨。然而，2003年1月22日房地美宣布将上调往年盈利数据后，情况却恰恰相反。1月21日至23日期间，这家抵押贷款公司的股价下跌了近5%，而标普500指数则基本持平。

<!--en-->
Ordinarily, a company's stock price rises when its reported earnings unexpectedly increase. The opposite occurred, however, after Freddie Mac announced on January 22, 2003, that it would revise upward its earnings for previous years. Between January 21 and January 23, the mortgage finance company's shares fell nearly 5 percent while the S&P 500 Index was essentially unchanged.

对于这一看似奇怪的反应，其解释在于：该公告引发了投资者对这家正式名称为联邦住房贷款抵押公司的政府资助企业财务报表可靠性的担忧。早在消息公布前，投资者就对房地美复杂的会计处理方式心存疑虑。当该公司的审计师普华永道（PwC）对该公司某些套期交易的历史会计处理方式提出质疑时，这种焦虑进一步加剧。在安达信因涉及安然审计案中的刑事指控而丧失上市公司审计资格后（详见第11章），普华永道便接手了房地美的审计工作。当普华永道审查2002年度业绩时，对安达信曾批准的会计决策提出了质疑，从而引发了可能出现更多问题的担忧。

<!--en-->
The explanation of this seemingly strange response was the concern that the announcement raised among investors about the reliability of the financial statements of the government-sponsored enterprise (GSE) officially known as the Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation. Even before the news, investors were apprehensive about the complexity of Freddie Mac's accounting. Anxiety increased when the company's auditor, PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), raised questions about the way the company treated past accounting for certain hedging transactions. After Arthur Andersen surrendered its licenses to audit public companies following its conviction on criminal charges relating to its handling of Enron's audit (see Chapter 11), PwC had taken over as Freddie Mac's auditor. When PwC reviewed the 2002 results, it questioned company accounting decisions that Arthur Andersen had approved, raising the possibility that further problems would emerge.

房地美坚决否认其衍生品处理旨在平滑盈利。也就是说，该公司声称自己并未在景气时期故意压低报告利润，以便日后能更容易地实现证券分析师所期望的稳定盈利增长。然而，2003年6月25日，房地美承认在某些情况下它确实操纵了盈利以符合华尔街的盈利预期。管理层仍辩称，2000年至2002年间被低估的净利润（估计在15亿至45亿美元之间）大多属于偶然失误。（到2003年11月公司财务报告审查完成时，这一数字已升至近50亿美元。）

<!--en-->
Freddie Mac steadfastly denied that its handling of derivatives was aimed at smoothing its earnings. That is, the company contended that it did not deliberately hold down its reported profits during good times, making it easier later on to post the steady earnings increases that security analysts craved. On June 25, 2003, however, Freddie Mac admitted that in some instances it manipulated its earnings to match Wall Street earnings forecasts. Management nevertheless claimed that most of the understatement of net income for 2000 through 2002, which it estimated at $1.5 billion to $4.5 billion, was accidental. (The figure rose to nearly $5 billion by the time a review of the company's financial reporting was completed in November 2003.)

即便有意虚报的情况在盈利低估中所占比例较小，该公司这些可疑做法所产生的影响依然巨大，以至于即使尽职的分析师也无法从外部察觉。房地美通过关联掉期交易将4.2亿美元的非公认会计准则利润（当时公司敦促投资者关注的指标）进行了时间转移。在这些交易中，该公司一方面押注利率上升，另一方面又押注利率下降。

<!--en-->
Even if it was true that intentional misrepresentations were the lesser part of the earnings understatement, the company's questionable practices had a huge impact that even conscientious analysts could not detect fromthe outside. Freddie Mac time-shifted $420 million of pro forma profits (the measure the company was then urging investors to focus on) through linked swaps. In these transactions, the company bet on a rise in interest rates at the same time that it bet on a decline in interest rates.

这种做法的净经济收益为零，除了改变利润入账时间外，几乎没有商业上的合理性可言。房地美设计的掉期交易模式是：在一个月份支付款项，而在下个月收到抵消性交易的款项。这导致当年净利润减少，而次年则有所增加。更仔细地审视利润情况……

<!--en-->
The net economic benefit was nil, and there was minimal business justification for the swaps, other than altering the timing of profits. Freddie Mac structured the swaps such that it made its payments in one month and received payment for the offsetting trade in the following month. That reduced net income in one year and raised it in the next.
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

房地美这种非经济驱动的金融工程手法也呈现出会计操纵中常见的特征，即虚假陈述不断累积放大。该公司于2001年开始使用关联掉期交易，因为利率下跌导致了盈利波动加剧。如果利率趋于平稳、使利润回归正常增长水平，房地美本可以逐步消化其建立的盈利储备。但利率持续走低，为了维持现状并避免报告出意外的盈利激增，管理层不得不进行规模越来越大的关联利率掉期交易。最终的那笔掉期交易所转移的利润超过了前八笔交易的总和。¹³ 房地美的操纵行为并未止步于此；另一种隐藏盈利的手段是停止对某些衍生品采用市场价格计价。

<!--en-->
Freddie Mac's noneconomically driven financial engineering also displayed a characteristic frequently observed in accounting manipulation, namely, snowballing misrepresentation. The company initiated its use of linked swaps in 2001 because falling interest rates were creating an earnings blizzard. If interest rates had leveled off, bringing profits down to a more normal growth rate, Freddie Mac could have begun working down the earnings reserve it had created. Instead, rates continued to fall. To keep the game going and avoid reporting an unwanted earnings spike, management had to undertake bigger and bigger linked-rate swaps. The final swap shifted more income than the first eight combined.¹³
Freddie Mac's manipulation did not end there. Another ploy to hide earnings consisted of ceasing to use market prices for certain derivatives.

外部调查人员将这一行为称为“以结果为导向、逆向设计且投机取巧”。¹⁴ 令人难以置信的是，剔除所有管理层的操作之后，结果显示该公司实际上将2001年的盈利*高估*了近10亿美元。

<!--en-->
Outside investigators labeled this action "results-oriented, reverse engineered, and opportunistic."¹⁴ Incredibly, it turned out that after all of management's maneuvers were stripped away, the net effect was that the company *overstated* its 2001 earnings by almost $1 billion.

从震慑未来违反公认会计原则的行为来看，房地美的恶行确实带来了惩罚。董事会解雇了公司总裁，并迫使首席执行官和首席财务官辞职。首席执行官由前首席投资官接任，但在其参与关联利率掉期交易的事实曝光后，他也最终丢了工作。此外，该公司在与联邦企业监管办公室达成的和解中支付了1.25亿美元的罚款。监管机构的报告将房地美不当行为的根源追溯至20世纪90年代中期。

<!--en-->
Encouragingly, from the standpoint of dissuading future abusers of GAAP, Freddie Mac's misdeeds brought retribution. The board fired the company's president and obtained the resignations of its chief executive officer and chief financial officer. The CEO was succeeded by the former chief investment officer, but he, too, eventually lost his job after his role in the linked-rate swaps came to light. In addition, the company paid a $125 million fine in a settlement with the Office of Federal Enterprise Oversight. The regulator's report traced the origins of Freddie Mac's inappropriate practices back to the mid-1990s.

此外，关于房地美会计做法的揭露也为那些试图限制房地美及其同类政府资助企业房利美权力的政客们提供了借口。这两家公司后来成为2008年金融危机的核心角色，并被置于政府托管之下。财务报告问题并非它们失宠的直接原因，但它们反映了导致不良财务行为的不健康企业文化。

<!--en-->
Furthermore, the revelations about Freddie Mac's accounting practices lent fuel to politicians' intent on reining in Freddie Mac and its fellow GSE, Fannie Mae. The two companies later became central figures in the financial crisis of 2008 and were placed under government conservatorship. Financial reporting issues were not the immediate cause of their fall from grace, but they were symptomatic of unhealthy corporate cultures that led to unsound financial practices.

## 结论

<!--en-->
*CONCLUSION*

正如企业有诸多方式来夸大营收一样，它们也会采用各种手段来压低费用。企业管理者会对可资本化的成本做出宽松的估算，堆积不合理的应计项目，利用一次性收益来冲销费用，甚至提前确认从供应商处获得的回扣。这些伎俩往往很难在企业的公开财务报表中被察觉，但那些看似微不足道却前所未有或违背常规的项目记录，却可能预示着重大的财务重述。为了捕捉到这些线索，分析师必须有足够的严谨性，不去轻信企业针对潜在问题所给出的那些看似合理的解释。

<!--en-->
Just as companies have myriad ways of exaggerating revenues, they follow a variety of approaches in downplaying expenses. Corporate managers make liberal assumptions about costs that may be capitalized, pile up unjustified accruals, dilute expenses with one-time gains, and jump the gun in booking rebates from suppliers. These gambits are often exceedingly difficult to detect in companies' public financial statements, but seemingly minor yet unprecedented or unconventional entries can foreshadow major restatements. To pick up such clues, analysts must be disciplined enough to disbelieve the innocent explanations that companies routinely provide for abnormalities that point to trouble down the road.

第八章

<!--en-->
CHAPTER 8

## EBITDA的应用与局限性

<!--en-->
*The Applications and Limitations of EBITDA*

正如第3章所述，近年来企业试图摆脱传统上主导其估值体系的税后利润导向。之所以试图将投资者的注意力转向营业利润或其他指标，是因为许多新经济公司录得的净利润微乎其微。按常规方法计算的这类公司的市盈率（P/E）往往会使它们的股票显得价格高昂。相比之下，传统经济公司的分母（即市盈率中的E）通常较大，因此它们的市盈率看起来就极为合理。

<!--en-->
As noted in Chapter 3, corporations have attempted in recent years to break free from the focus on after-tax earnings that has traditionally dominated their valuation. The impetus for trying to redirect investors' focus to operating income or other variants has been the minimal net profits recorded by many New Economy companies. Conventionally calculated price-earnings (P/E) multiples of such companies, most inconveniently, make their stocks look expensive. Old Economy companies generally have larger denominators (the E in P/E), so their multiples look extremely reasonable by comparison.

早在互联网公司开始寻求净利润的替代指标之前，财务报表的使用者就已经发现了净利润作为估值工具的某些局限性。他们注意到，同一行业的两家公司可能报告相似的利润，但其**企业总价值**却存在显著差异。同样，信贷分析师也发现，在某一特定年份里，两家公司可能产生相近的利润水平以覆盖相似的利息支出，但它们未来违约的风险却截然不同。

<!--en-->
Long before the dot-com companies began seeking alternatives to net income, users of financial statements had discovered certain limitations in net income as a valuation tool. They observed that two companies in the same industry could report similar income yet have substantially different **total enterprise values**. Similarly, credit analysts realized that in a given year, two companies could generate similar levels of income to cover similar levels of interest expense yet represent highly dissimilar risks of defaulting on their debt in the future.

令分析师们失望的是，净利润并不能作为衡量所有公司价值与风险的统一标准。倘若他们能深入思考这一问题，或许会推测出：根本不存在一种能够全面反映财务绩效、从而承担此重任的单一指标。然而，他们却执意寻找那个能准确衡量企业盈利能力的单一指标，其信念之坚定，犹如那些追寻埃尔多拉多宝藏的征服者一般。161 利润的深层剖析

<!--en-->
Net income was not, to the disappointment of analysts, a standard by which every company's value and risk could be compared. Had they thought deeply about the problem, they might have hypothesized that *no* single measure could capture financial performance comprehensively enough to fulfill such a role. Instead, they set off in quest of the correct single measure of corporate profitability, believing in its existence as resolutely as the conquistadors who went in search of El Dorado.
161
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

### 息税前利润、EBITDA和企业总价值

<!--en-->
*EBIT, EBITDA, AND TOTAL ENTERPRISE VALUE*

虚构的Deep Hock与Breathing Room案例（附件8.1）说明了将净利润与企业总价值相关联时所存在的问题。这两家公司均在thingmabob行业内竞争。它们最近一年的净利润分别为2860万美元和3300万美元。

<!--en-->
The fictitious case of Deep Hock and Breathing Room (Exhibit 8.1) illustrates the problems of relating net income to total enterprise value. Both companies compete within the thingmabob industry. Their net profits for the latest year are $28.6 million and $33.0 million, respectively.

当Breathing Room宣布以6.66亿美元的价格被一家跨国电子产品制造商收购时，Deep Hock的创始人兼控股股东菲利普·阿特利意识到自己的公司在并购市场上颇具吸引力。他自信于自身的谈判能力，于是省去了并购顾问，直接联系了此前曾有意收购Deep Hock的投资集团。鉴于电子产品制造商的需求旺盛，阿特利认为现在正是出售公司的良机。

<!--en-->
When Breathing Room announces an agreement to be acquired by a multinational thingmabob producer for $666 million, Deep Hock's founder and controlling shareholder, Philip Atlee, realizes that his company is a hot item in the mergers-and-acquisitions (M&A) market. Trusting his own skills as a negotiator, he dispenses with M&A advisers and directly contacts an investor group that has previously approached him about buying Deep Hock. With thingmabob makers in strong demand, Atlee reasons, now is the time to sell.

Breathing Room的售价相当于其3300万美元净利润的20倍，这一数字与其他近期收购案例中的定价水平相符。基于此，Atlee将目标定在Deep Hock公司2860万美元净利润的20倍，即5.72亿美元。他以更高的价格开始谈判，经过一番讨价还价后，最终接受了5.72亿美元的报价。开香槟庆祝之后，Atlee便开始物色游艇。

<!--en-->
Breathing Room's selling price represented a multiple of 20 times its $33.0 million net income, in line with levels paid in other recent thingmabob acquisitions. On that basis, Atlee sets his sights on a price of 20 times Deep Hock's $28.6 million of net income, or $572 million. He starts the negotiations at a higher level and, after some haggling, accepts a $572 million offer. After popping open the champagne, Atlee begins shopping for a yacht.

一个月后，阿特利平静的退休生活被一则消息粗暴地打断：收购了Deep Hock的投资者们迅速将其以6.66亿美元的价格转售给了一家大型工业企业。这位前首席执行官沮丧地意识到，自己显然白白损失了9400万美元。面对这出人意料的局面，阿特利百思不得其解：究竟为什么有人会花6.66亿美元来购买Deep Hock？这一价格甚至与收购Breathing Room时的价格相当，而后者净利润还要高出15%。显然，那个花费5.72亿美元购得Deep Hock的投资集团不可能在一个月内就大幅提升其利润；与此同时，那些名不见经传的公司市盈率也并未从20倍上涨。

<!--en-->
One month later, Atlee's quiet retirement is rudely disturbed by news that the investors who bought Deep Hock have quickly resold it to a large industrial corporation for $666 million. The ex-CEO realizes, to his dismay,that he apparently left $94 million on the table. Dumbfounded by the turn of events, Atlee wonders why anyone would pay $666 million for Deep Hock. That is equivalent to the price paid for Breathing Room, a company with net income 15 percent higher. Surely, the investment group that paid $572 million for Deep Hock could not have boosted its profits materially in the space of a month. Neither have price-earnings ratios on thingmabob companies risen from 20 times in the interim.

为解开这个谜团，阿特利向他的侄女艾拉娜寻求解释。艾拉娜是一家投资管理公司的实习生。凭借她分析财务报表的经验，她指出：Deep Hock的营业利润为5000万美元，与Breathing Room持平。两者在净利润上的差异源于Breathing Room没有债务，因此无需支付利息费用。

<!--en-->
The Applications and Limitations of EBITDA
Determined to solve the mystery, Atlee seeks an explanation from his niece, Alana, an intern at an investment management firm. Drawing on her experience in analyzing financial statements, she obliges by pointing out that Deep Hock's income from operations, at $50.0 million, is equivalent to Breathing Room's. The difference at the bottom line arises because Breathing Room, with a debt-free balance sheet, has no interest expense.

“如果我收购了你的公司，菲尔叔叔，”艾拉娜解释道，“我会立即编制模拟财务报表，展示在还清所有债务后Deep Hock的净利润会是多少。没有了670万美元的利息费用，其税前利润将达到5000万美元，与Breathing Room相同。按照该公司34%的实际税率计算，所缴税款会更高（1700万美元，而Breathing Room仅为1470万美元），但净利润将从2860万美元上升至3300万美元，与Breathing Room持平。随后我会以20倍市盈率的价格出售该公司，即6.66亿美元。很可能那群投资者在从你手中收购Deep Hock后就是这么做的。”

<!--en-->
"If I had bought your company, Uncle Phil," Alana explains, "I would have immediately created pro forma financials showing what Deep Hock's net income would be if all of its debt were paid off. Without the $6.7 million of interest expense, its income before income taxes would be $50.0 million, just like Breathing Room's. At the company's effective tax rate of 34 percent, the tax bill would be higher ($17.0 million versus $14.7 million), but net income would rise from $28.6 million to $33.0 million, the same as at Breathing Room. Then I would put the company up for sale at 20 times earnings, or $666 million. That's probably what that group of investors did after they bought Deep Hock from you."

艾拉娜停顿片刻，补充了一个关于该交易的细节。

<!--en-->
Pausing for effect, Alana adds a detail concerning the transaction.

“为了将Deep Hock的实际净利润从2860万美元提高到3300万美元——而非仅靠模拟数据——必须有人偿还那670万美元的债务。假设投资集团还清了借款并以无债状态出售公司，那么卖方的净收益并非你以为的9400万美元，而只有2700万美元。我提这一点，只是希望能给你一点安慰。另一种交易结构是将这670万美元的债务纳入6.66亿美元的收购价中。无论哪种方式，卖方最终获得的现金均为5.99亿美元，即2700万美元的快捷利润。”

<!--en-->
"In order to raise Deep Hock's earnings from $28.6 million to $33.0 million on an actual, as opposed to a pro forma basis, somebody has to retire the $6.7 million of debt. Assuming the investor group paid off the borrowings and sold the company debt-free, its net gain wasn't $94 million, as you assumed, but only $27 million. I mention that, just in case it's any consolation to you. An alternative way to structure the deal would have been to make the $6.7 million debt assumption part of the $666 million purchase price. Either way, the net cash proceeds to the seller come to $599 million, for a quick profit of $27 million."

尽管对未能卖出高价仍感不满，但阿特利被侄女在财务报表分析方面的见解所吸引，于是继续问道：“我现在明白了，用净利润乘以倍数来比较资本结构不同的公司的企业价值并不妥当。这种情况想必经常发生。有没有一种简单直接的估值方法，能告诉我们公司的真实价值，哪怕我们没聪明到想到通过消除债务来提高盈利？”

<!--en-->
Still unhappy about failing to get top dollar but intrigued by his niece's insights into financial statement analysis, Atlee asks a follow-up question. "I see now that applying a multiple to net income is not a good way to compare the total enterprise values of companies with dissimilar capital structures. This kind of situation must arise frequently. Is there a simple, direct valuation method that would have shown us what our company was truly worth, even if we weren't clever enough to think of increasing the earnings by eliminating the debt?"
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS
"Yes," answers Alana.

“有的，”艾拉娜回答道，“你不应以模拟交易——也就是Breathing Room的出售案例——中的净利润来计算倍数，而应以EBIT的倍数来计算。EBIT代表‘息税前利润’。将Breathing Room的净利润、所得税和利息费用相加即可得到分母；分子则是出售价格。”

<!--en-->
"Instead of calculating a multiple of net income on the comparable transaction, that is, the sale of Breathing Room, you should have calculated a multiple of EBIT. That stands for 'earnings before interest and taxes.' Add Breathing Room's net income, income taxes, and interest expense to get the denominator. The numerator is the sale price:

$$ 
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\text{Total Enterprise Value}}{\text{Net Income} + \text{Income Taxes} + \text{Interest Expense}} &= \frac{\$666}{\$33.0 + 17.0 + 0.0} \\
&= 13.32\text{X}
\end{aligned}
 $$

“让我们把同样的13.32这一EBIT倍数应用到Deep Hock损益表中的相关数据上，”艾拉娜继续说道。

<!--en-->
"Let's apply that same EBIT multiple of 13.32 to the comparable data from Deep Hock's income statement," Alana continues.

$$ 
\begin{aligned}
\text{Net Income} + \text{Income Taxes} + \text{Interest Expense} &= \$28.6 + 14.7 + 6.7 \\
&= \$50.0 \\
\$50.0 \times 13.32 &= \$666.0
\end{aligned}
 $$

“原来专业人士就是靠这种方法来确保具有相似经营特征但财务策略不同的公司之间的估值倍数保持一致吗？”这位既难过又明智的前Deep Hock首席执行官问道。

<!--en-->
"So that's how the pros ensure that valuation multiples will be consistent between companies with similar operating characteristics but different financial strategies?" asks the sadder but wiser ex-CEO of Deep Hock.

“其实，菲尔叔叔，”艾拉娜回答道，“还有一个可比性问题需要解决。如您所知，会计准则赋予企业在确定固定资产折旧年限方面相当大的自主权；无形资产摊销计划也是如此。现在，假设Breathing Room的管理层每年计提的资产折旧不是2500万美元，而只有2000万美元。这意味着他们的资产折旧速度比你们更慢，因为两家公司的折旧率原本是相同的。以下是根据这一假设的折旧率变动调整后的Breathing Room损益表”（图表8.2）。

<!--en-->
"Actually, Uncle Phil," Alana replies, "there's one more comparability issue that we need to address. As you know, the accounting standards leave companies considerable discretion regarding the depreciable lives they assign to their property, plant, and equipment. The same applies to amortization schedules for intangible assets. Now, let's imagine for a moment that Breathing Room's managers had been writing off its assets not at a rate of $25 million a year, but only $20 million a year. That means that they would have been depreciating assets more slowly than you were, since the two companies' rates of depreciation were identical. Here's Breathing Room's income statement, revised for this hypothetical change in depreciation rates" (Exhibit 8.2).

“让我们根据这张报表计算出EBIT，并应用我们此前分析得出的、目前用于评估thingmabob类公司价值的EBIT倍数。”

<!--en-->
"Let's calculate EBIT from this statement and apply the EBIT multiple that, according to our previous analysis, represents the value being assigned to thingmabob companies currently:

$$ 
\begin{aligned}
\text{Net Income} + \text{Income Taxes} + \text{Interest Expense} &= \$36.3 + 18.7 + 0.0 \\
&= \$55.0 \\
\$55.0 \times 13.32 &= \$732.6 \text{ million}
\end{aligned}
 $$

EBITDA的应用与局限 *图表8.2 Breathing Room, Inc.*

<!--en-->
The Applications and Limitations of EBITDA
*EXHIBIT 8.2 Breathing Room, Inc.*

<table><thead><tr><th colspan="2">Statement of Consolidated Income</th></tr><tr><th colspan="2">Year Ended December 31, 2010</th></tr><tr><th colspan="2">($000 omitted)</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Sales</td><td>$500.0</td></tr><tr><td>Cost of sales</td><td>415.0</td></tr><tr><td>Depreciation and amortization</td><td>20.0</td></tr><tr><td>Selling, general, and administrative expense</td><td>10.0</td></tr><tr><td>Operating income</td><td>55.0</td></tr><tr><td>Interest expense</td><td>0.0</td></tr><tr><td>Income before income taxes</td><td>55.0</td></tr><tr><td>Provision for income taxes</td><td>18.7</td></tr><tr><td>Net Income</td><td>$ 36.3</td></tr></tbody></table>

“看来仅仅通过延长资产的折旧年限，Breathing Room公司的价值就从6.66亿美元提升到了7.326亿美元。但这显然不合理。折旧属于应计项目，而非现金支出。因此，为财务报告目的而改变折旧率只不过是对会计记录的调整而已；它并不会增加或减少实际流入公司的资金数额。如果管理层是为了税务申报而更改折旧率，那么实际缴纳的税款就会减少，此时更多的资金才会流入Breathing Room公司。但那是另一回事。我们担心的是，Breathing Room公司可能仅仅因为会计政策上的差异——而这种差异并不反映经济价值的差别——就能比Deep Hock公司卖出更高的价格。”

<!--en-->
"It appears that simply by stretching out the depreciable lives of its assets, Breathing Room has boosted its value from $666 million to $732.6 million. But that can't be correct. Depreciation is an accrual, rather than a cash expense. Changing the depreciation rate for financial reporting purposes is therefore nothing but an alteration of a bookkeeping entry. It doesn't increase or decrease the number of dollars actually flowing into the company. If management had changed the depreciation rate for tax reporting purposes, then the actual tax payments would decline. In that case, more dollars *would* flow into Breathing Room. But that's another matter. What we're concerned about is that Breathing Room might fetch a higher price than Deep Hock, merely because of a difference in accounting policy that represents no difference in economic value.

“为防止此类扭曲现象，我们采用比EBIT更理想的基数来计算倍数，这个基数就是EBITDA。它的全称是‘息税折旧摊销前利润’。（没错，我知道在损益表中，从上到下的正确顺序确实是EBIT；但惯例是使用缩写EBITDA，发音为‘eebit-dah’。）无论Breathing Room公司每年按2500万美元还是2000万美元的速率计提资产折旧，其EBITDA倍数都是相同的：”

<!--en-->
"To prevent this sort of distortion, we calculate a multiple on a base that's even better than EBIT. It's called EBITDA. That stands for 'earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.' (Yes, I know that on the income statement, the correct order, moving from top to bottom, is EBIT. But the convention is to use the acronym EBITDA, pronounced 'eebit-dah.') Breathing Room's EBITDA multiple is the same, whether it depreciates its assets at the rate of $25 million a year or $20 million a year:

$$ \text{EBITDA Multiple} = \frac{\text{Total Enterprise Value}}{\text{Net Income} + \text{Income Taxes} + \text{Interest Expense} + \text{Depreciation} + \text{Amortization}} $$

“原有的折旧计划：”

<!--en-->
"Original depreciation schedule:

$$ \frac{\$666}{\$33 + 17.0 + 0.0 + 25.0} = \frac{\$666}{75} = 8.88\text{X} $$

利润详析：“放缓后的折旧计划：”

<!--en-->
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS
"Decelerated depreciation schedule:

$$ \frac{\$666}{\$36.3 + 18.7 + 0.0 + 20.0} = \frac{\$666}{75} = 8.88X $$

“如果我们计算出Deep Hock公司的EBITDA，并套用同样的8.88倍倍数，就能得出6.66亿美元的正确企业总价值；这意味着我们在资本结构和折旧政策方面实现了可比性：”

<!--en-->
"If we calculate Deep Hock's EBITDA and apply that same multiple of 8.88X, we get the correct total enterprise value of $666 million, meaning that we've achieved comparability with respect to both capital structure and depreciation policy:

$$ \begin{aligned} \text{Net Income} + \text{Income Taxes} + \text{Interest Expense} \\ + \text{Depreciation} + \text{Amortization} \\ = \$28.6 + 14.7 + 6.7 + 25.0 \\ = \$75.0 \\ \$75.0 \times 8.88 = \$666.0 \end{aligned} $$

“总之，菲尔叔叔，用EBITDA的倍数来计算企业总价值，要比使用净利润明智得多。但最重要的教训是：如果您决定退休后重操旧业、创办新公司，一定要聘请我担任您的财务顾问。”

<!--en-->
"In summary, Uncle Phil, it's much smarter to calculate total enterprise value as a multiple of EBITDA than to use net income. But the most important lesson is that if you decide to come out of retirement and start another company, be sure to hire me as your financial adviser."

阿特利咧嘴笑道：“我想，学习更新且更好的财务报表分析方法永远都不算晚。”

<!--en-->
Atlee grins. "I guess you're never too old to learn new and better approaches to financial statement analysis."

### EBITDA在信贷分析中的作用

<!--en-->
*THE ROLE OF EBITDA IN CREDIT ANALYSIS*

菲尔·阿特利与其侄女之间的对话表明：即便净利润相近，类似的企业其企业总价值也可能存在显著差异。同理，利息保障倍数相近的公司，其违约风险也可能大不相同。在信贷分析中，正如对企业估值一样，EBITDA能够区分那些从EBIT角度看看似相似的企业。以Rock Solid Corporation和Hollowman, Inc.这两个虚构公司为例（见图8.3）。

<!--en-->
The dialogue between Phil Atlee and his niece shows that similar companies with similar net income can have substantially different total enterprise values. Much in the same way, companies with similar interest coverage can have substantially different default risk. In credit analysis, as in valuing businesses, EBITDA can discriminate among companies that look similar when judged in terms of EBIT. Consider the fictitious examples of Rock Solid Corporation and Hollowman, Inc. (Exhibit 8.3).

根据常规的固定费用偿付能力指标（第13章）来衡量，这两家公司具有同等的风险水平，其比率分别为2.10X和2.11X：

<!--en-->
Measured by conventional fixed charge coverage (Chapter 13), the two companies look equally risky, with ratios of 2.10X and 2.11X, respectively:

固定费用偿付能力：

<!--en-->
Fixed charge coverage:

$$ \text{Net Income} + \text{Income Taxes} + \text{Interest Expense} $$

利息支出：

<!--en-->
Interest expense:

$$ \text{Rock Solid Corp.: } \frac{\$73.0 + 37.0 + 100.0}{\$100.0} = 2.10X $$

$$ \text{Hollowman, Inc.: } \frac{\$66.0 + 34.0 + 90.0}{\$90.0} = 2.11X $$

EBITDA的应用与局限性 ***图表8.3** 对比财务数据（单位：千美元，省略了末尾的“000”）截至2010年12月31日止年度*

<!--en-->
The Applications and Limitations of EBITDA
***EXHIBIT 8.3** Comparative Financial Data ($000 omitted) Year Ended December 31, 2010*

（为便于阐述，我们将这一标准的信贷衡量指标称为基于EBIT的偿付能力比率。需要注意的是，对于某些公司而言，净利润、所得税费用和利息支出的总和并不等于EBIT，这反映出在税前利润以下还存在一些特殊项目及少数股东权益等因素。）

<!--en-->
(For convenience of exposition, we refer to this standard credit measure as the EBIT-based coverage ratio. Note that for some companies, the sum of net income, income taxes, and interest expense is not equivalent to EBIT, reflecting the presence of such factors as extraordinary items and minority interest below the pretax income line.)

实际上，Hollowman和Rock Solid在**财务杠杆**方面几乎完全一致，而财务杠杆也是衡量信贷风险的另一项标准指标。（关于在更复杂情况下如何计算总债务对总资本比率，请参阅第13章。）总债务对总资本比率：

<!--en-->
As it happens, Hollowman and Rock Solid are almost perfectly matched on **financial leverage**, another standard measure of credit risk. (For a discussion of calculating the total-debt-to-total-capital ratio in more complex cases, see Chapter 13.)
Total-debt-to-total-capital ratio:

$$ \frac{\text{Total Debt}}{\text{Total Debt} + \text{Equity}} $$

$$ \text{Rock Solid Corp.: } \frac{\$950.00}{\$950.0 + 750.0} = 55.9\% $$

$$ \text{Hollowman, Inc.: } \frac{\$875.0}{\$875.0 + 675.0} = 56.5\% $$

按照这些标准，向Hollowman, Inc.放贷与向Rock Solid Corp.放贷一样安全。然而，若将EBITDA纳入分析，就会发现Rock Solid在业务低迷时期更能保障利息支付能力。

<!--en-->
By these criteria, lending to Hollowman, Inc. is as safe a proposition as lending to Rock Solid Corp. Bringing EBITDA into the analysis, however, reveals that Rock Solid is better able to keep up its interest payments in the event of a business downturn.

本年度，Rock Solid的毛利润——即销售额减去销售成本——为4亿美元。假设由于收入减少和利润率恶化，这一数字下降40%至2.4亿美元，而其他运营费用保持不变（参见图表8.4）。此时营业利润仅为5000万美元，仅相当于1亿美元利息支出的一半。固定费用覆盖比率从先前计算的2.10X降至0.50X。**更仔细地审视利润情况**

<!--en-->
In the current year, Rock Solid's gross profit—sales less cost of goods sold—is $400 million. Suppose that through a combination of reducedrevenue and margin deterioration, the figure drops by 40 percent to $240 million, while other operating expenses remain constant (Exhibit 8.4). Operating income now totals only $50 million, just half of the $100 million interest expense. Fixed charge coverage falls to 0.50X from the previously calculated 2.10X.
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

***图表8.4** 损益表（单位：千美元，省略零）截至2010年12月31日*

<!--en-->
***EXHIBIT 8.4** Statements of Income ($000 omitted) Year Ended December 31, 2010*

<table><thead><tr><th></th><th>Rock Solid Corporation</th><th>Hollowman, Inc.</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>销售额</td><td>$1,800.0</td><td>$1,575.0</td></tr><tr><td>销售成本</td><td>1,560.0</td><td>1,365.0</td></tr><tr><td>折旧与摊销</td><td>75.0</td><td>30.0</td></tr><tr><td>销售、一般及行政费用</td><td>115.0</td><td>130.0</td></tr><tr><td>营业利润</td><td>50.0</td><td>50.0</td></tr><tr><td>利息费用</td><td>100.0</td><td>90.0</td></tr><tr><td>税前利润（亏损）</td><td>(50.0)</td><td>(40.0)</td></tr><tr><td>所得税计提（抵免）</td><td>(17.0)</td><td>(14.0)</td></tr><tr><td>净利润（亏损）</td><td>$ (33.0)</td><td>$ (26.0)</td></tr></tbody></table>

<!--en-->
<table><thead><tr><th></th><th>Rock Solid Corporation</th><th>Hollowman, Inc.</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Sales</td><td>$1,800.0</td><td>$1,575.0</td></tr><tr><td>Cost of sales</td><td>1,560.0</td><td>1,365.0</td></tr><tr><td>Depreciation and amortization</td><td>75.0</td><td>30.0</td></tr><tr><td>Selling, general, and administrative expense</td><td>115.0</td><td>130.0</td></tr><tr><td>Operating income</td><td>50.0</td><td>50.0</td></tr><tr><td>Interest expense</td><td>100.0</td><td>90.0</td></tr><tr><td>Income (loss) before income taxes</td><td>(50.0)</td><td>(40.0)</td></tr><tr><td>Provision (credit) for income taxes</td><td>(17.0)</td><td>(14.0)</td></tr><tr><td>Net income (loss)</td><td>$ (33.0)</td><td>$ (26.0)</td></tr></tbody></table>

Rock Solid真的无法支付债务利息吗？并非如此，因为计入利润的7500万美元折旧与摊销属于会计记录，并非当年实际现金支出。将这些非现金费用加回后可以发现，该公司仍能勉强维持运营，其利息覆盖比率达到1.25X：

<!--en-->
Is Rock Solid truly unable to pay the interest on its debt? No, because the $75.0 million of depreciation and amortization charged against income is an accounting entry, rather than a current-year outlay of cash. Adding back these noncash charges shows that the company keeps its head above water, covering its interest by a margin of 1.25X:

基于EBITDA的利息覆盖比率：

<!--en-->
EBITDA coverage of interest:

$$ \begin{aligned} \text{Net Income} + \text{Income Taxes} + \text{Interest Expense} \\ + \text{Depreciation} + \text{Amortization} \end{aligned} = \text{Interest Expense} $$

$$ \frac{\$ (33.0) + (17.0) + 100.0 + 75.0}{100.0} = 1.25X $$

相比之下，如果Hollowman的毛利润也像图表8.4所示那样下降40%，那么即便按EBITDA计算，其利息覆盖比率也会低于1.0倍：

<!--en-->
By contrast, if Hollowman's gross profit falls by 40 percent, as also shown in Exhibit 8.4, its interest coverage is below 1.0 times, even on an EBITDA basis:

$$ \frac{\$ (26.0) + (14.0) + 90.0 + 30.0}{90.0} = 0.89X $$

Rock Solid能够承受比Hollowman更大的毛利率降幅，而不会丧失足额支付利息所需的现金流。

<!--en-->
Rock Solid can sustain a larger decline in gross margin than Hollowman can before it will cease to generate sufficient cash to pay its interest in full.

EBITDA的应用与局限性原因在于：非现金折旧费用在Rock Solid总运营费用中所占比例更大——占17.9亿美元的4.2%，而Hollowman仅占15.6亿美元的1.9%（参见图表8.3）。这一差异反映出Rock Solid的业务比Hollowman更依赖资本投入。进一步查阅两家公司的财务报表可能会发现，Rock Solid的资产中用于购置物业、厂房及设备的比例更高。

<!--en-->
The Applications and Limitations of EBITDA
The reason is that noncash depreciation charges represent a larger portion of Rock Solid's total operating expenses—4.2 percent of $1.790 billion, versus 1.9 percent of $1.560 billion for Hollowman (Exhibit 8.3). This difference, in turn, indicates that Rock Solid's business is more capital-intensive than Hollowman's. Further examination of the companies' financial statements would probably show Rock Solid to have a larger percentage of total assets concentrated in property, plant, and equipment.

总之，从传统指标来看，两家公司的固定费用覆盖比率几乎相同，但在支付利息的违约可能性上却存在显著差异。引入EBITDA后，分析师便能区分这两种看似相似的信用风险。这也是该比率广受欢迎的第二个重要原因；另一个原因是它在估算企业整体价值时，有助于确保具有不同折旧政策的公司之间具备可比性。

<!--en-->
In summary, conventionally measured fixed charge coverage is nearly identical for the two companies, yet they differ significantly in their probability of defaulting on interest payments. Taking EBITDA into account enables analysts to discriminate between the two similar-looking credit risks. This is a second major reason for the ratio's popularity, along with its usefulness in ensuring comparability of companies with dissimilar depreciation policies, when estimating the total enterprise values.

## 滥用EBITDA

<!--en-->
*ABUSING EBITDA*

与许多其他财务比率一样，正确使用EBITDA能够提供有价值的洞察。然而，在错误的情境下应用它时，却可能产生误导。从前面的示例中便可看出滥用的迹象：通过将折旧计入分子，管理层可以强调（在此案例中确实是合理的）尽管Rock Solid的营业利润仅够支付2001年利息支出的50%，但该公司产生的现金量却是该需求的125%。贷款人仅仅因为看到这一比率超过1.0X，而非低于此阈值，便会感到些许安心。

<!--en-->
Like many other financial ratios, EBITDA can provide valuable insight when used properly. It is potentially misleading, however, when applied in the wrong context. A tip-off to the possibility of abuse is apparent from the preceding illustration. By adding depreciation to the numerator, management can emphasize (legitimately, in this case) that although Rock Solid's operating profits suffice to pay only 50 percent of its 2001 interest bill, the company is generating 125 percent as much cash as it needs for that purpose. Lenders derive a certain amount of comfort simply from focusing on a ratio that exceeds 1.0X, rather than one that falls below that threshold.

为了持续寻求廉价资本，杠杆收购的发起人敏锐地注意到：无论通过何种方式实现，只要偿债覆盖率大于1.0X，贷款人就会感到安心。为了最大限度地利用这种效应，发起人竭力将分析师的注意力从传统的固定费用覆盖率转向以EBITDA为基础的利息覆盖率。在20世纪80年代，这种策略对转移投资者注意力尤为有效；当时一些收购案的杠杆率极高，以至于即便在业绩良好的年份，预计的EBIT也不足以覆盖备考利息支出。

<!--en-->
In their perennial quest for cheap capital, sponsors of leveraged buyouts have noted with interest the comfort that lenders derive from a coverage ratio greater than 1.0X, regardless of the means by which it is achieved. To exploit the effect as fully as possible, the sponsors endeavor to steer analysts' focus away from traditional fixed charge coverage and toward EBITDA coverage of interest. Shifting investors' attention was particularly beneficial during the 1980s, when some buyouts were so highly leveraged that projected EBIT would not cover pro forma interest expense even in a good year.

发起人通过大肆宣扬超过1.0倍这一心理临界点的EBITDA覆盖率来安抚紧张的投资者。与此同时，发起人的投资银行家们暗示：那些执着于低于1.0X的EBIT覆盖率的传统派人士，其分析方法早已过时且过于保守。

<!--en-->
The sponsors reassured nervous investors by ballyhooing EBITDA coverage ratios that exceeded the psychologically critical threshold of 1.0 times. Meanwhile, the sponsors' investment bankers insinuated that traditionalists who fixated on sub-1.0X EBIT coverage ratios were hopelessly antiquated and unreasonably conservative in their analysis.

事实上，在将折旧计入利息覆盖率计算时，确实应当谨慎对待。支持采用基于EBITDA而非基于EBIT的固定费用覆盖率的观点，其实建立在一种隐含假设之上。只有在企业能够推迟大部分资本支出而不损害其未来竞争力的时期内，将折旧计入分子才是恰当的。更深入地审视利润

<!--en-->
In truth, a bit of caution is advisable in the matter of counting depreciation toward interest coverage. The argument for favoring the EBITDA-basedover EBIT-based fixed charge coverage rests on a hidden assumption. Adding depreciation to the numerator is appropriate only for the period over which a company can put off a substantial portion of its capital spending without impairing its future competitiveness.
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

在一个完整的经营周期内，企业现金流量表中报告的资本支出通常至少会等于损益表上显示的折旧费用。企业必须修复设备的物理损耗；更换陈旧设备也需要额外开支。实际上，随着企业为了满足日益增长的需求而扩大生产能力，资本支出很可能会随时间推移超过折旧额。

<!--en-->
Over a full operating cycle, the capital expenditures reported in a company's statement of cash flows are ordinarily at least as great as the depreciation charges shown on its income statement. The company must repair the physical wear and tear on its equipment. Additional outlays are required for the replacement of obsolete equipment. If anything, capital spending is likely to exceed depreciation over time, as the company expands its productive capacity to accommodate rising demand.

资本支出可能高于折旧的另一个原因是：由于通货膨胀因素，新购置的设备成本往往高于被计提折旧的旧设备。

<!--en-->
Another reason that capital spending may run higher than depreciation is that newly acquired equipment may be costlier than the old equipment being written off, as a function of inflation.

鉴于持续需要替换和扩充生产能力，折旧所代表的现金流实际上并不能真正用于支付利息，至少无法长期如此。换言之，EBITDA中的“D”只是企业财务主管在EBIT短期低于利息支出时的一个应急手段。在这种情况下，企业可以暂时削减资本支出，从而腾出部分折旧现金流来支付利息。只要利润下滑仅持续几个季度，推迟那些虽必要但不紧急的设备采购与维修，就不会对企业的运营造成持久损害。然而，如果企业年复一年仅在不动产、厂房及设备上投入最低限度的资金，大多数企业将失去竞争优势。20世纪80年代那些杠杆率极高的收购案的发起人声称其企业能在长期内用远低于EBIT的金额支付利息仍能保持健康，这种说法显然是不诚实的。

<!--en-->
In view of the ongoing need to replace and add to productive capacity, the cash flow represented by depreciation is not truly available for paying interest, at least not on any permanent basis. Rather, the *D* in EBITDA is a safety valve that the corporate treasurer can use if EBIT falls below *I* for a short time. Under such conditions, the company can temporarily reduce its capital spending, freeing up some of its depreciation cash flow for interest payments. Delaying equipment purchases and repairs that are essential, but not urgent, should inflict no lasting damage on the company's operations, provided the profit slump lasts for only a few quarters. Most companies, however, would lose their competitive edge if they spent only the bare minimum on property, plant, and equipment, year after year. It was disingenuous for sponsors of the most highly leveraged buyouts of the 1980s to suggest that their companies could remain healthy while paying interest substantially greater than EBIT over extended periods.

自然地，发起人对这一质疑早有圆滑的回应。他们声称，在收购前，管理层在厂房和设备上的开支过度；那些已被罢免的首席执行官们据称浪费了数十亿美元用于那些纯粹满足其虚荣心的项目，而非具有经济合理性的企业投资。事实上，正是这些低回报项目的投资导致股价变得低廉，从而使企业易于被收购。投资者理应为此感到欣慰而非担忧——毕竟收购后资本支出大幅减少。当然，当发起人与原首席执行官联手进行管理层主导的收购时，这种说辞的说服力便大打折扣。

<!--en-->
Naturally, the sponsors were prepared with glib answers to this objection. Prior to the buyout, they claimed, management had been overspending on plant and equipment. The now-deposed chief executives allegedly had wasted billions on projects that were monuments to their egos, rather than economically sound corporate investments. In fact, the story went, investments in low-return projects were the cause of the stock becoming cheap enough to make the company vulnerable to takeover. Investors ought to be pleased, rather than alarmed, to see capital expenditures fall precipitously after the buyout. Naturally, this line of reasoning was less persuasive in cases where the sponsors teamed up with the incumbent CEO in a management-led buyout.

在20世纪80年代的许多交易中，投资者被告知可以放心：年度利息支出中有一部分是零息债券的溢价摊销，而非传统的现金利息支付。具体来说，投资者会在债券初次发行时以大幅折价（比如面值的50%）购入零息债券。他们不会收到定期的利息支付，而是通过债券价格的逐步上涨来获取投资回报。

<!--en-->
Investors in many of the 1980s transactions were advised to take comfort as well from the fact that a portion of the annual interest expense consisted of accretion on zero-coupon bonds, rather than conventional cash coupons(interest payments). By way of explanation, investors buy a zero-coupon issue in its initial distribution at a steep discount—say, 50 percent—to its face value. Instead of receiving periodic interest payments, the purchasers earn a return on their investment through a gradual rise in the bond's price.

在债券到期时，债务人必须按面值的100%赎回该证券。

<!--en-->
At the bond's maturity, the obligor must redeem the security at 100 percent of its face value.

EBITDA的应用与局限：通过结合使用零息融资和传统债务，杠杆收购的发起人能够制定出看似合理的财务预测——既显示所有利息能按时支付，又能保证足够的资本开支以维持公司的竞争力。这些预测往往乐观地假定巨额偿债义务可通过出售资产所得资金来偿还。发起人宣称，他们将通过处置那些所谓非核心资产来筹集大量现金。

<!--en-->
The Applications and Limitations of EBITDA
By using zero-coupon financing along with conventional debt, LBO sponsors could generate financial projections that showed all interest being paid on schedule, while at the same time making capital expenditures large enough to keep the company competitive. Often, the projections optimistically assumed that the huge debt repayment obligations would be financed with the proceeds of asset sales. The sponsors declared that they would raise immense quantities of cash by unloading supposedly nonessential assets.

事后看来，许多杠杆收购财务预测背后的假设过于激进。不过，发起人的论点也并非毫无根据。至少有一些在20世纪80年代进行杠杆收购的大型多元化企业，确实存在应当取消的资本项目；一些臃肿的企业集团还持有完全值得剥离的无效资产。

<!--en-->
With the benefit of hindsight, the assumptions behind many of the LBOs' financial projections were extremely aggressive. Still, the sponsors' arguments were not entirely unfounded. At least some of the vast, diversified corporations that undertook leveraged buyouts during the 1980s had capital projects that deserved to be canceled. Some of the bloated conglomerates owned deadweight assets that were well worth shedding.

然而，随后出现的一系列与杠杆收购相关的债券违约事件，¹证明了那些对这种新型企业融资方式持怀疑态度的分析师们的观点是正确的。

<!--en-->
The subsequent wave of LBO-related bond defaults,¹ however, vindicated analysts who had voiced skepticism about the new-styled corporate finance.

毕竟，折旧并不能作为长期用于支付利息的现金来源。这一教训不仅适用于20世纪80年代的高杠杆交易，也适用于后来更为保守的资本结构交易。

<!--en-->
Depreciation was not, after all, available as a long-run source of cash for interest payments. This was a lesson applicable not only to the extremely leveraged deals of the 1980s but also to the more conservatively capitalized transactions of later years.

### 更全面的现金流衡量指标

<!--en-->
*A MORE COMPREHENSIVE CASH FLOW MEASURE*

尽管EBITDA在量化信用风险方面存在局限，但它已成为证券分析中的常用工具。如今，许多从业者将该比率视为现金流的同义词，或更正式地说，即经营性现金流（OCF）。鉴于长期以来实证研究一直将现金流与破产风险相关联，分析师心中EBITDA与OCF的可互换性具有极其重要的意义。

<!--en-->
Despite its limitations as a tool for quantifying credit risk, EBITDA has become a fixture in securities analysis. Many practitioners now consider the ratio synonymous with cash flow or, more formally, operating cash flow (OCF). The interchangeability of EBITDA and OCF in analysts' minds is extremely significant in light of a long tradition of empirical research linking cash flow and bankruptcy risk.

在1966年的一项具有影响力的研究²中，威廉·H·比弗测试了多种可作为公司破产预测指标的财务比率。他测试的比率中包括一种至今仍被广泛使用的现金流定义。根据比弗（1966）的定义，现金流是指：

<!--en-->
In an influential 1966 study,² William H. Beaver tested various financial ratios as predictors of corporate bankruptcy. Among the ratios he tested was a definition of cash flow still widely used today. Cash flow (as defined by Beaver, 1966) is:

$$
\text{Net Income} + \text{Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization}
$$

深入剖析利润情况

<!--en-->
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

（耗竭是一种针对自然资源资产的非现金费用，通常被认为已包含在折旧和摊销之中，因此使用缩写EBITDA而非EBITDDA。）

<!--en-->
(Depletion, a noncash expense applied to natural resource assets, is ordinarily taken to be implicit in depreciation and amortization, hence the use of the acronym EBITDA, rather than EBITDDA.)

比弗发现，在他测试的所有比率中，最能预测破产的是现金流与总债务比率的下降趋势。这种关系符合直觉：如果净利润下降或总债务增加，都会导致现金流与总债务比率降低，从而加大破产风险。实证证据表明，通过将折旧计入分子，分析师预测哪些公司会破产的能力得到了提升——这比仅比较总债务与净利润要有效得多。

<!--en-->
Beaver found that of all the ratios he tested, the best single predictor of bankruptcy was a declining trend in the ratio of cash flow to total debt. This relationship made intuitive sense. Practitioners reasoned that bankruptcy risk was likely to increase if net income declined or total debt increased, either of which would reduce the cash-flow-to-total-debt ratio. The empirical evidence indicated that by adding depreciation to the numerator, analysts improved their ability to predict which companies would go bust, relative to comparing total debt with net income alone.

需要注意的是，比弗定义的现金流比EBITDA更为严格，因为他并未将所得税或利息加回净利润。即便如此，债券分析师们还是形成了一种传统：将违约风险简化为现金流（即EBITDA）占总债务百分比这一单一比率，而这一切最终源于比弗1966年的研究结果³。通过这种方式，从业者将一种比弗从未提倡、且后续经验证明存在致命缺陷的方法制度化了。

<!--en-->
Note that Beaver's definition of cash flow was more stringent than EBITDA, since he did not add back either taxes or interest to net income. Even so, bond analysts have developed a tradition of telescoping default risk into the single ratio of cash flow (meaning EBITDA) as a percentage of total debt, all based ultimately on Beaver's 1966 finding.³ In so doing, practitioners have institutionalized a method that Beaver never advocated and that subsequent experience has shown to be fatally flawed.

比弗并未断言分析师应仅依赖现金流与债务比率，他只是认为这是最佳的单一破产预测指标。正如他在研究中指出的，其他学者早已尝试通过组合多个比率进行**多变量**分析，以构建预测能力更强的破产模型。到1966年，尚未有人成功，但仅仅两年后，爱德华·I·奥尔特曼便提出了由五个比率组成的多变量模型⁴（见第13章）。奥尔特曼Z分数及其他多变量模型的发展表明：没有任何单一财务比率能像精心挑选的一组比率那样准确地预测破产。

<!--en-->
Beaver did not conclude that analysts should rely solely on the ratio of cash flow to debt ratio, but merely that it was the single best bankruptcy predictor. As he noted in his study, other academic researchers were already attempting to build bankruptcy models with greater predictive power by combining ratios into a **multivariate** analysis. As of 1966, no one had yet succeeded, but just two years later, Edward I. Altman introduced a multivariate model composed of five ratios⁴ (see Chapter 13). The development of Altman's Z-Score and other multivariate models has demonstrated that no single financial ratio predicts bankruptcy as accurately as a properly selected combination of ratios.

自1968年以来，将破产风险简化为仅以EBITDA与总债务之比来衡量已毫无道理可言。然而，这种做法至今仍很普遍。同样缺乏依据的是，根据实证证据来看，那种仅用单一变量——即企业EBITDA对利息的覆盖能力——来对借款企业进行排序的方法也被广泛采用。

<!--en-->
Since 1968, there has been no excuse for reducing bankruptcy risk to the sole measure of EBITDA to total debt. Nevertheless, that procedure remains a common practice. Similarly unjustifiable, on the basis of empirical evidence, is the widely used one-variable approach of ranking a sample of corporate borrowers according to their EBITDA coverage of interest.

奇怪的是，投资经理有时会让债券分析师按照“实际信用风险”对公司进行排名，而非依据穆迪或标准普尔评级。

<!--en-->
Bizarrely, investment managers sometimes ask bond analysts to provide rankings of companies by their “actual credit risk,” as opposed to Moody's and Standard & Poor's ratings.

当被要求解释这一要求时，投资经理们回答说，所谓“实际风险”显然就是指EBITDA对利息的覆盖能力。显然他们认为：由他们所定义的现金流与固定费用之比，能比所有评级机构所采用的定量和定性指标加起来更能准确预测破产风险。投资经理们并未意识到，他们此举实际上使信用分析倒退了30多年！

<!--en-->
Asked to elaborate on this request, the investment managers reply that actual risk *obviously* means EBITDA coverage. Apparently, they consider it self-evident that the single ratio of cash flow (as they define it) to fixed charges predicts bankruptcy better than all of the rating agencies' quantitative and qualitative considerations combined. Little do the investment managers realize that they are setting credit analysis back by more than 30 years!

EBITDA的应用与局限：与单纯依赖单一的EBITDA比率一样过时的，是分析师们认为只需选取某种形式的盈利并加上折旧就能得出令人满意的现金流指标的看法。早在1975年W.T. Grant申请破产时，人们就已发现EBITDA以及净利润加折旧都并非现金流的有效替代指标。这家百货连锁店的倒闭表明，依赖“盈利加折旧”指标可能导致分析师忽视那些营运资金需求庞大的公司的潜在弱点。此后零售业和服装业中的多次企业倒闭也印证了这一结论。

<!--en-->
The Applications and Limitations of EBITDA
Nearly as outmoded as exclusive reliance on a single EBITDA-based ratio is analysts' belief that they can derive a satisfactory measure of cash flow by simply selecting some version of earnings and adding back depreciation. It became apparent that neither EBITDA nor net income plus depreciation was a valid proxy for cash flow at least as far back as 1975, when W. T. Grant filed for bankruptcy. The department store chain's collapse showed that reliance on an earnings-plus-depreciation measure could cause analysts to overlook weakness at a company with substantial working capital needs. Many subsequent failures in the retailing and apparel industries have corroborated that finding.

在申请破产时，W.T. Grant是美国最大的零售商。

<!--en-->
At the time of its bankruptcy filing, W. T. Grant was the largest retailer in the United States.

在其倒闭前两年，该公司仍报告为正净利润（参见图表8.5）。此外，这家百货连锁店还拥有正向且稳定的现金流（按Beaver的定义，即净利润加折旧）。因此，尽管从20世纪60年代末到70年代初该公司的净利润并未增长，但破产似乎仍遥不可及。1973年，W.T. Grant的股票交易价格达到市盈率的20倍，显示出投资者对该公司未来的强烈信心。

<!--en-->
Up until two years before it went belly-up, the company reported positive net income (see Exhibit 8.5). Moreover, the department store chain enjoyed positive and stable cash flow (as defined by Beaver, in other words, net income plus depreciation). Bankruptcy therefore seemed a remote prospect, even though the company's net income failed to grow between the late 1960s and early 1970s. In 1973, W. T. Grant's stock traded at 20 times earnings, indicating strong investor confidence in the company's

深入剖析利润情况

<!--en-->
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

董事会通过持续批准发放股息直至1974年年中，进一步强化了这种信心。

<!--en-->
future. The board of directors reinforced that confidence by continuing to authorize dividends until mid-1974.

如果投资者能超越损益表上显示的现金来源（盈利和折旧）与用途（利息和股息），他们或许就不会如此乐观。必须调查资产负债表中的两个项目——存货和应收账款——是否占用了越来越多的现金。若是如此，就必须确定公司能否通过增加应付账款来产生相应的现金补偿。鉴于这种深入分析的重要性，财务会计准则委员会（FASB）最终在SFAS 95《现金流量表》中规定了更为全面的“经营活动现金流”定义。

<!--en-->
Investors would have been less sanguine if they had looked beyond the cash sources (earnings and depreciation) and uses (interest and dividends) shown on the income statement. It was imperative to investigate whether two balance sheet items, inventories and accounts receivable, were tying up increasing amounts of cash. If so, it became vital to determine whether the company could generate an offsetting amount of cash by expanding its accounts payable. Recognizing the need for this added level of analysis, the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) eventually prescribed a more comprehensive definition of *operating cash flow*, as defined in SFAS 95, “Statement of Cash Flows.”

经营活动现金流（按FASB 1987年的定义）：

<!--en-->
Operating cash flow (as defined by FASB, 1987):

$$
\text{Net Income} + \text{Depreciation} - \text{Changes in Working Capital Requirements}
$$

其中：

<!--en-->
Where

$$
\text{Working Capital Requirements} = \text{Accounts Receivable} + \text{Inventory} - \text{Accounts Payable}
$$

请注意，该定义侧重于通常与经营规模成比例增长的营运资本要素。FASB的定义排除了现金、有价证券以及短期债务。

<!--en-->
Note that this definition focuses on the elements of working capital that ordinarily grow roughly in proportion with the scale of operations. The FASB formulation excludes cash and marketable securities, as well as short-term debt.

### 营运资本为现金流分析增添重要维度

<!--en-->
*WORKING CAPITAL ADDS PUNCH TO CASH FLOW ANALYSIS*

将营运资本纳入现金流分析，常常能揭示出仅靠观察EBITDA或净利润加折旧趋势所无法察觉的问题。事实上，由于涉及存货或应收账款的操作手法，报告的盈利往往高于真实的经济利润。幸运的是，这类操纵手段会留下明显的痕迹。除季节性因素外，企业运营所需的营运资本通常占销售额的相对稳定比例。因此，如果存货或应收账款占销售额的比例显著上升，分析师应高度怀疑盈利被高估，即便管理层总会给出较为温和的解释。

<!--en-->
Adding working capital to cash flow analysis frequently reveals problems that may not be apparent from observing the trend of EBITDA or net income plus depreciation. In fact, reported earnings often exceed true economic profits specifically as a function of gambits involving inventories or accounts receivable. Fortunately, such ploys leave telltale signs of earnings manipulation. Aside from seasonal variations, the amount of working capital needed to run a business represents a fairly constant percentage of a company's sales. Therefore, if inventories or receivables increase materially as a percentage of sales, analysts should strongly suspect that the earnings are overstated, even though management will invariably offer a more benign explanation.

EBITDA的应用与局限性  
以一家服装制造商为例：它必须在确定下一季哪些新款式会受消费者青睐之前就开始生产。假设管理层对时尚趋势的判断出现失误，公司便会持有只能以低价出售的存货。为了不承认这些过时服装的价值损失，管理层可能会选择将其继续保留在产成品库存中。根据会计理论，公司应当通过计提存货跌价准备来确认这一损失。但在实践中，管理层或许能说服审计师称并未发生价值损失——毕竟判断何为时尚本身具有主观性。此外，管理层还可以辩称存货滞留只是因为订单暂时减少所致。即便审计师相信这一说辞，也无法改变公司已经遭受经济损失的事实。那些仅关注EBITDA的分析师根本不会察觉到盈利下滑或公司现金流可能已趋紧张的状况。

<!--en-->
The Applications and Limitations of EBITDA
Consider, for example, an apparel manufacturer that must produce its garments before knowing which new styles will catch the fancy of shoppers in the season ahead. Suppose that management guesses wrong about the fashion trend. The company now holds inventory that can be sold, if at all, only at knockdown prices. Instead of selling the unfashionable garments, which would force the manufacturer to recognize the loss in value, management may decide to retain them in its finished goods inventory. Accounting theory states that the company should nevertheless recognize the loss by writing down the merchandise. In practice, though, management may persuade its auditors that no loss of value has occurred. After all, judging what is fashionable is a subjective process. Moreover, management can always argue that the goods remain in its warehouse only because of a temporary slowdown in orders. If the auditors buy the story, it will not alter the fact that the company has suffered an economic loss. Analysts focusing exclusively on EBITDA will have no inkling that earnings are down or that the company's cash resources may be starting to strain.

相比之下，如果分析师监测的是包含营运资本在内的现金流指标（而非仅仅依赖净利润和折旧），他们就能发现异常。当本季产品仍留在存货中时，公司同时也在为下一季生产服装。请留意随着新产品进入存货，营运资本需求的变化情况——需参照FASB 95的定义来理解：

<!--en-->
In contrast, analysts will recognize that something is amiss if they monitor a cash flow measure that includes working capital in addition to net income and depreciation. While the current season's goods remain in inventory, the company is producing clothing for the next season. Observe what happens to working capital requirements, bearing in mind the FASB 95 definition, as the new production enters inventory:

$$
\text{Working Capital Requirements} = \text{Accounts Receivable} + \text{Inventory} - \text{Accounts Payable}
$$

存货增加会导致营运资本需求上升。根据FASB的定义，营运资本需求的上升会削弱经营性现金流。尽管净利润加折旧仍在稳步增长，但分析师此时会收到危险信号。

<!--en-->
Inventory increases, causing working capital requirements to increase. According to the FASB definition, a rise in working capital requirements reduces operating cash flow. Analysts receive a danger signal, even though net income plus depreciation advances steadily.

应收账款的激增同样会减少经营性现金流。应收账款的累积可能反映出两类潜在问题：一方面，管理层可能为刺激销售而放宽对现有客户的信贷条件，从而给予财务状况不佳的客户更长的付款期限；如此一来，平均应收账款水平将高于以往，这会占用更多现金并迫使公司承担原本由客户支付的融资成本。另一方面，应收账款的增加也可能源于向信用状况较差的新客户授予信贷，而这些客户付款速度较慢。为应对此类客户违约风险的增加，公司应计提更多的坏账准备，进而导致当期报告利润下降。遗憾的是，企业并不总能遵循良好的会计惯例行事。

<!--en-->
A surge in accounts receivable, similarly, would reduce operating cash flow. The buildup in receivables could signal either of two types of underlying problems. On the one hand, management may be trying to prop up sales by liberalizing credit terms to its existing customers. Specifically, the company may be carrying financially strained businesses by giving them more time to pay up their accounts. If so, average accounts receivable will be higher than in the past. That will soak up more cash and force the company to absorb financing costs formerly borne by its customers. Alternately, a buildup in receivables may result from extension of credit to new, less creditworthy customers that pay their bills comparatively slowly. To reflect the greater propensity of such customers to fail on their obligations, the company ought to increase its reserve for bad debts. Current-period reportedincome would then decline. Unfortunately, companies do not invariably do what they ought to do, according to good accounting practice.

若企业未能这样做，包含营运资本需求的现金流指标便能揭示出净利润加折旧或EBITDA所无法察觉的弱点。更深入地审视利润情况……

<!--en-->
If they do not, a cash flow measure that includes working capital requirements will reveal a weakness not detected by net income plus depreciation or EBITDA.
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

当然，管理层可能会试图通过增加营运资本的第三个组成部分——应付账款来掩盖存货或应收账款相关的问题。如果公司拖延支付自身账款，应付账款的增加或许能抵消资产方面的增长。不过对分析师而言幸运的是，企业在使用这一手段前往往会三思而后行，因为这可能对经营活动产生负面影响：供应商可能会将付款延迟视为财务恶化的迹象，进而导致重要的商业信贷来源枯竭。

<!--en-->
To be sure, management may attempt to mask problems related to inventory or receivables by pumping up the third component of working capital requirements, accounts payable. If the company takes longer to pay its own bills, the resulting rise in payables may offset the increase on the asset side. Fortunately for analysts, companies think twice before playing this card, because of potential repercussions on operations. The company's suppliers might view a slowdown in payments as a sign of financial weakness. Vital trade credit could dry up as a consequence.

无论如何，分析师应将经营性现金流作为众多诊断工具之一，而不应单独依赖它，正如他们不应仅通过追踪EBITDA来进行监控一样。如果公司通过延长应付账款周期来应对问题，第13章中详述的其他比率（如应收账款与销售额之比、存货与销货成本之比）仍会发出警告信号。还需注意的是：如果公司未通过延长应付账款或动用现金来应对存货和应收账款的膨胀，就必然会增加借款。

<!--en-->
In any case, analysts should use operating cash flow as one of many diagnostic tools. They should not rely on it exclusively, any more than they should limit their surveillance solely to tracking EBITDA. If a company resorts to stretching out its payables, other ratios detailed in Chapter 13 (receivables to sales and inventories to cost of goods sold) will nevertheless send out warning signals. Note, as well, that if the company does not finance the bulge in inventories and receivables by extending its payables or drawing down cash, it must add to its borrowings.

因此，债务资本比率的上升（参见第13章）可以印证经营性现金流所揭示的不良信贷趋势。

<!--en-->
Accordingly, a rising debt-to-capital ratio (see Chapter 13) can confirm an adverse credit trend revealed by operating cash flow.

## 结论

<!--en-->
*CONCLUSION*

尽管无数事实证明：没有哪一项指标能够全面反映公司的财务特征，但投资者仍继续寻找所谓的“万能指标”。他们告诉自己：如果公司价值并非直接取决于净利润，那一定是净利润受到了税率和财务杠杆等偶然因素的过度影响。因此，解决办法就是转向损益表中更靠前的指标，以使不同公司之间的比较更加公平。正如前美林证券投资策略师理查德·伯恩斯坦所指出的那样，⁵营业利润往往比报告利润更稳定，EBIT又比营业利润更稳定，而EBITDA则比EBIT更稳定。公司欢迎这种向波动性更小的业绩指标过渡的趋势，因为投资者会以较高的市盈率来奖励稳定性。这种向损益表上游指标发展的趋势在20世纪90年代末的科技股热潮中达到了顶峰——投资者开始以市销率来估值股票，从而选取最稳定、最高的指标。（为了掩盖真相，一些公司甚至开始谈论“扣除费用前的盈利”，即EBE。）

<!--en-->
Despite repeated demonstrations of the truism that no single measure encapsulates all of a company's pertinent financial traits, investors continue to search for the silver bullet. If a company's value is not a direct function of its net income, they tell themselves, the problem must be that net income is too greatly affected by incidental factors such as tax rates and financial leverage. The answer must be to move up the income statement to a measure that puts companies on a more even plane with one another. As former Merrill Lynch investment strategist Richard Bernstein points out,⁵ operating earnings tend to be stabler than reported earnings, EBIT tends to be stabler than operating earnings, and EBITDA tends to be stabler than EBIT. Companies welcome analytical migration toward less variable measures of performance, because investors reward stability with high price-earnings multiples. The trend of moving up the income statement reached its logical conclusion during the technology stock boom of the late 1990s. Investors latched onto the highest, most stable figure of all by valuing stocks on price-sales ratios. (To obscure what was going on, some companies actually resorted to discussing their earnings before expenses, or EBE.)

EBITDA的应用与局限性 177

<!--en-->
The Applications and Limitations of EBITDA
177

策略师伯恩斯坦发现，试图剔除公司盈利中的波动性因素，反而降低了投资者选股的有效性。

<!--en-->
Strategist Bernstein found that by attempting to filter out the volatility inherent in companies' earnings, investors reduced the effectiveness of their stock selection.

在一项涵盖1986年至2001年7月的研究中，他比较了基于低市盈率选出的股票组合与基于低EBITDA倍数、现金流倍数、账面价值倍数及销售额倍数选出的股票组合的表现。传统的低市盈率标准产生了最高的平均回报率（16.7%）。而以低企业总价值⁶与EBITDA之比选出的股票组合，其平均回报率仅为12.3%。即便考虑到风险因素，依靠净利润这一最终指标也比采用EBITDA能获得更好的结果。伯恩斯坦的研究再次强调：财务报表分析师不应寻求能完全概括公司绩效的替代性指标，而应综合考察多种指标以获得最全面的洞察。

<!--en-->
In a study spanning the period 1986 to July 2001, he compared the performance of portfolios of stocks based on low ratios of price to earnings with alternative portfolios of stocks priced at low multiples of EBITDA, cash flow, book value, and sales. The good old-fashioned low P/E criterion produced the highest average return (16.7 percent) of any of the strategies. Stocks chosen on the basis of low total enterprise value⁶ to EBITDA produced the lowest average return, 12.3 percent. Adjusted for risk, as well, investors achieved far better results by relying on the bottom line, net income, instead of moving up the income statement to EBITDA. Bernstein's findings reinforced the message that instead of seeking an alternative to net income that summarizes corporate performance in its entirety, analysts of financial statements should examine a variety of measures to derive maximum insight.
