第9章

<!--en-->
CHAPTER 9

### 信息披露与审计的可靠性

<!--en-->
*The Reliability of Disclosure and Audits*

天真的观察者可能会认为，仔细审查公司财务报表以确认管理层是否如实反映情况实属多余。毕竟，严格的法规要求上市公司必须披露会影响其证券价值的重大事件。即使管理层有意操纵数据，投资者还有第二道防线：由训练有素的审计师进行的年度财务认证。美国证券交易委员会（SEC）的公司金融与执法部门则提供了额外的保障。

<!--en-->
A naive observer might consider it overkill to scrutinize a company's financial statements for signs that management is presenting anything less than a candid picture. After all, extensive regulations compel publicly traded corporations to disclose material events affecting the value of their securities. Even if a company's management is inclined to finagle, investors have a second line of defense in the form of mandatory annual certification of the financials by highly trained auditors. The Securities and Exchange Commission's (SEC) Corporation Finance and Enforcement divisions provide an additional line of defense.

这些论述准确描述了该体系本应为财务报表使用者带来的益处。然而，与许多其他情况一样，当依赖法律机制来保护股东和债权人时，理论与现实之间存在着巨大差距。诚然，对违法后果的恐惧能在一定程度上约束企业管理者。但在许多高管看来，“曲解”法律则是另一回事。如果他们的奖金取决于能否将业绩呈现得过于乐观，他们通常总能找到办法做到这一点。

<!--en-->
These arguments accurately portray how the system is supposed to work for the benefit of the users of financial statements. As in so many other situations, however, the gap between theory and practice is substantial when it comes to relying on legal mechanisms to protect shareholders and lenders. Up to a point, it is true, fear of the consequences of breaking the law keeps corporate managers in line. *Bending* the law is another matter, though, in the minds of many executives. If their bonuses depend on presenting results in an unfairly favorable light, they can usually see their way clear to adopting that course.

用商界成功手册中的术语来说，“完成任务”绝对包括与审计师就会计准则的可放宽范围进行强硬谈判。从技术上讲，董事会负责任命审计事务所，但管理层才是具体商定对外披露细节的对接人。专业卓越的标准（必须承认，这对大多数会计师而言至关重要）与担心失去客户的恐惧之间，必然存在张力。

<!--en-->
Getting the job done, in the corporate world's success-manual jargon, most definitely includes hard-nosed negotiating with auditors over the limits to which the accounting standards may be stretched. Technically, the board of directors appoints the auditing firm, but management is the point of contact in hashing out the details of presenting financial events for external consumption. A tension necessarily exists between standards of professional excellence (which, it must be acknowledged, matter a great deal to most accountants) and fear of the consequences of losing a client.

在某个时刻，注销账户会成为一种道德上的必然选择，但在现实世界中，会计师事务所往往需要被强烈推动才能走到那一步。作为晋升为管理层前的历练过程，会计师们逐渐习惯了大学会计课程中那些清晰明确的规则与实际应用中模糊不清的界限之间的差距。因此，一线审计师常常会对公司管理层提出的激进会计处理方式提出异议，但最终还是会被资深同事否决。更仔细地审视利润问题

<!--en-->
At some point, resigning the account becomes a moral imperative, but in the real world, accounting firms must be pushed rather far to reachthat point. As a part of the seasoning process leading to a managerial role, accountants become reconciled to certain discontinuities between the bright, white lines drawn in college accounting courses and the fuzzy boundaries for applying the rules. Consequently, it is common for frontline auditors to balk at an aggressive accounting treatment proposed by a company's managers, only to be overruled by their senior colleagues.
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

即便审计师能够顶住那些认为生活中一切皆可谈判的公司管理层的压力，这种讨价还价的结果也未必能真实反映公司的财务业绩。

<!--en-->
Even if the auditors hold their ground against corporate managers who believe that everything in life is a negotiation, the outcome of the haggling will not necessarily be a fair picture of the company's financial performance.

极端情况下，高管可能会伪造财务数据。欺诈行为显然违反了会计准则，但审计并不总能察觉到它。出于成本考虑，审计人员无法逐一审查每一笔交易或检查每个仓库是否真的存有账面上所记载的存货。相反，他们依赖抽样检查。一旦抽查到错误的项目，伪造的数据便可能逃过检测。极其狡猾的骗子甚至能设法干扰审计人员随机选取样本的过程——而这一程序正是为了防止欺诈行为被掩盖。

<!--en-->
At the extreme, executives may falsify their results. Fraud is an unambiguous violation of accounting standards, but audits do not invariably catch it. Cost considerations preclude reviewing every transaction or examining every bin to see whether it actually contains the inventory attributed to it. Instead, auditors rely on sampling. If they happen to inspect the wrong items, falsified data will go undetected. Extremely clever scamsters may even succeed in undermining the auditors' efforts to select their samples at random, a procedure designed to foil concealment of fraud.

当被问及数字上的不一致时，公司有时会归咎于失误，而非有意误导财务报表使用者。2001年4月16日，Computer Associates International初步报告称，截至3月31日的财年每股营业利润为0.40美元。到了5月4日，这家软件生产商将这一数字修正为0.16美元。管理层称这一差异源于排版错误；据公司称，一名员工在准备新闻稿时误抄了一个数字。¹投资者对此持怀疑态度也在情理之中——就在5月4日公告发布前，Computer Associates的会计做法刚刚受到媒体的抨击。

<!--en-->
When challenged on inconsistencies in their numbers, companies sometimes blame error, rather than any intention to mislead the users of financial statements. On April 16, 2001, Computer Associates International preliminarily reported operating earnings of $0.40 a share for the fiscal year ended March 31. On May 4, the software producer put the figure at $0.16. The discrepancy, said management, resulted from a typographical error. According to the company, an employee transcribed a number incorrectly in preparing a news release.¹
Investors might have been excused for reacting skeptically. Shortly before the May 4 announcement, Computer Associates' accounting practices had come under attack in the press.

此外，熟悉企业界动态的观察者都明白，公司并不总是像投资者所期望的那样坦诚相告。以下来自赌场行业的例子便说明了这一点。

<!--en-->
Besides, seasoned followers of the corporate scene realize that companies are not always as forthcoming as investors might reasonably expect. The following examples from the casino business illustrate the point.

### 巧妙的交易

<!--en-->
*AN ARTFUL DEAL*

1999年10月25日，Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts公布第三季度每股收益从0.24美元升至0.63美元，这一增长排除了因关闭Trump World’s Fair Casino Hotel而产生的一次性费用。这一净利润超过了分析师预测的每股0.54美元，²促使特朗普公司的股价从4美元跃升至4又5/16美元。当天，该公司旗下特朗普大西洋城赌场发行的债券价格也上涨了约1个点，达到84又1/4。

<!--en-->
On October 25, 1999, Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts reported a year-over-year rise in its third-quarter earnings per share, from $0.24 to $0.63, excluding a one-time charge related to the closing of the Trump World's Fair Casino Hotel. The net exceeded analysts' consensus forecast of $0.54 a share,² resulting in a jump in Trump's share price from $4 to $4 5/16. Also up on the day were the bonds of one of the company's casinos, Trump Atlantic City, which climbed about one point to 84 1/4.

信息披露与审计的可靠性 181

<!--en-->
The Reliability of Disclosure and Audits
181

“1999年我们的重点有三方面，”总裁兼首席执行官尼古拉斯·里比斯在解释这一令行业分析师惊讶的利润激增现象时说道，“首先，提高各运营实体的营业利润率；其次，降低营销成本；第三，增加非赌场业务的现金销售。我们在这三个方面都取得了积极成果。”³该公司自我吹嘘的新闻稿中并未提及推动第三季度营收及净利润增长的另一个重要因素。直到后来提交的10-Q季度报告中才承认：该期间1720万美元的营收源自破产的餐饮运营商Planet Hollywood放弃其在特朗普泰姬陵赌场内All Star Café的租赁权。

<!--en-->
"Our focus in 1999 was threefold," said President and Chief Executive Officer Nicholas Ribis, in explaining the profit surge, which surprised industry analysts. "First, to increase our operating margins at each operating entity; second, to decrease our marketing costs; and third, to increase our cash sales from our non-casino operations. We have succeeded in achieving positive results in each of these three categories."³
The company's self-congratulatory press release contained no mention of another important contributor to the third-quarter surge in revenues and, by extension, net income. As the subsequently filed quarterly report on Form 10-Q finally acknowledged, $17.2 million of the period's revenue arose from bankrupt restaurant operator Planet Hollywood's abandonment of its lease on the All Star Café at Trump's Taj Mahal casino.

随着租赁关系的终止，所有装修和改造工程以及某些其他资产都归特朗普公司所有，该公司随后接管了该餐厅的运营。独立评估机构认定特朗普公司所获资产价值为1720万美元。若没有这笔收入，该公司的营收将会同比下降，净利润也会低于而非超过分析师的预期。

<!--en-->
With the termination of the lease, all improvements and alterations, along with certain other assets, became the property of Trump, which took over the restaurant's operation. An independent appraisal valued the assets received by Trump at $17.2 million. Without that boost, the company's revenues would have declined, year over year, and net income would have undershot, rather than exceeded, analysts' expectations.

据《华尔街日报》报道，10月25日披露的信息与10-Q报告中更为详尽的会计记录之间的差距，让Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts感到“十分尴尬”。⁴而且时机也不巧——这一事件发生在管理层正进行一系列投资者推介活动之际，旨在争取支持以在新泽西州大西洋城、已关闭的世界博览会赌场原址上开发新度假村。

<!--en-->
The discrepancy between the October 25 disclosure and the fuller accounting in the 10-Q "became an embarrassment" to Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts, according to the *Wall Street Journal*.⁴ Moreover, the timing was unfortunate. The incident occurred as management was making a round of investor presentations aimed at generating support for its plans to develop a new resort on the Atlantic City, New Jersey, site of the shuttered World's Fair casino.

更糟糕的是，从公司的角度来看，特朗普遗漏了一些相当有用的信息这一事实是可以察觉到的。贝尔斯登公司的债券分析师汤姆·尚德尔注意到，该公司的新闻稿中报道的特朗普泰姬陵赌场收入异常之高。该部门的收入比1998年同期增加了490万美元，尽管新泽西州赌场控制委员会报告称泰姬陵赌场的*赌场*收入减少了1210万美元。

<!--en-->
Worse yet, from the company's standpoint, the fact that Trump had omitted some rather useful information was detectable. Bear, Stearns & Co. bond analyst Tom Shandell noticed that the company's press release reported mysteriously large revenues for the Trump Taj Mahal. The unit's revenues increased by $4.9 million over the comparable 1998 quarter, even though the New Jersey Casino Control Commission reported a $12.1 million decline in the Taj Mahal's *casino* revenues.

尚德尔怀疑数字中隐藏着其他未注明的大型项目，这种推测是正确的；所谓490万美元的增长额与委员会报告的1210万美元的降幅之间的差异，实际上与后来曝光的1720万美元的All Star Café资产数额完全一致。如果特朗普在1999年第三季度新闻稿中对泰姬陵赌场的运营情况提供与1998年相应的详细数据，就无需进行此类推断或数字推算了。然而事实并非如此，正如图表9.1所示。

<!--en-->
Shandell was correct in suspecting that some other large, unspecified item was buried in the numbers; the difference between the purported $4.9 million increase and the commission's reported decline of $12.1 million was essentially identical to the $17.2 million of All Star Café assets that later came to light. No such inference or backing out of numbers would have been required if Trump's third-quarter 1999 press release had provided as much detail on the Taj Mahal's operations as the corresponding 1998 release. That was not the case, however, as Exhibit 9.1 demonstrates.

特朗普在1999年第三季度财报中大幅削减披露内容，是否属于刻意掩盖某一事实的企图呢？——更深入地审视利润情况

<!--en-->

披露与审计的可靠性：年度营收增长是否完全归因于一次性事件？公司总裁并不这么认为。“这从未被隐瞒，”里比斯坚称，“一旦有人专门询问，我们就会详细说明。”他补充道，All Star Café带来的收益在混乱中被忽略了；当时律师们催促他在启动新赌场路演前公布第三季度财报。里比斯还说：“我一得知相关会计处理方式后，便立即与所有投资者和分析师进行了沟通。”里比斯声称自己是在季度业绩公布后才发现公司年度盈利增长的真正来源，这一说法显然有损其细致严谨的形象。这种所谓的“疏忽”或许无法解释为何七个月后特朗普酒店及赌场度假村决定不再续签即将到期的里比斯的CEO合同。也许这与截至2000年5月的12个月内特朗普股价下跌56%更为相关。但有一点是肯定的：仅依赖公司披露的投资者，若因那份看似乐观的新闻稿而跟风买入，最终必将遭受损失。在分析师尚德尔查明All Star Café对第三季度业绩的贡献后，股价迅速从4 5/16美元跌至3 7/8美元，而特朗普大西洋城债券的价位也从84 1/4跌至80。2002年1月16日，特朗普酒店及赌场同意与美国证监会达成和解，承认其在此事件中“轻率地”误导了投资者，但并未承认或否认证监会的调查结果。⁷

<!--en-->
The Reliability of Disclosure and Audits year-over-year revenue gain was solely attributable to a nonrecurring event? Not to hear the company's president tell it. "It was never hidden," Ribis insisted. "When there was a specific question about it, we broke it out."⁵ The gain on the All Star Café simply got lost in the shuffle, he maintained, when the lawyers pressed him to put out third-quarter earnings before commencing the road show for the proposed new casino. "As soon as I learned of the accounting treatment we spoke with all of our investors and analysts," added Ribis.⁶
By apparently claiming that he discovered the true source of his company's year-over-year earnings increase only after the quarterly results had been released, Ribis did not burnish his reputation as a details man. That professed shortcoming may not explain why, seven months later, Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts decided not to renew Ribis's expiring contract as CEO. Perhaps it had more to do with the 56 percent drop in Trump's stock price in the 12 months ending May 2000. One thing is certain, however. Investors who relied solely on the company's disclosure were burned if they bought into the rally that followed the bullish-sounding press release. After analyst Shandell's inquiries uncovered the All Star Café's contribution to third-quarter results, the stock promptly sagged from $4 5/16 to $3 7/8, while the Trump Atlantic City bonds slid from 84 1/4 to 80. On January 16, 2002, Trump Hotels and Casinos agreed to settle SEC charges that it "recklessly" misled investors in this incident, without admitting or denying the commission's findings.⁷

## 遗产税

<!--en-->
*DEATH DUTIES*

在特朗普酒店及赌场度假村争议爆发的同期，博彩行业也再次展现了依赖公司披露的潜在风险。1999年6月，帕克普莱斯娱乐公司首席执行官亚瑟·戈德堡入院治疗。公司称其病因是呼吸道感染，但传言称他病情严重。⁸到7月7日戈德堡出院时，帕克普莱斯的股价已下跌6%。同一时期，芝加哥期权交易所博彩指数所涵盖的12只股票平均涨幅却达到8%。

<!--en-->
In roughly the same period in which the Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts controversy arose, the gambling industry provided another example of the hazards of relying on company disclosures. Arthur Goldberg, chief executive officer of Park Place Entertainment, entered the hospital in June 1999. The company attributed his confinement to a respiratory infection, but rumors began to circulate that he was gravely ill.⁸ By the time Goldberg was released from the hospital on July 7, Park Place's stock had fallen by 6 percent. Over the same period, the 12 stocks constituting the Chicago Board Options Exchange Gaming Index rose by an average of 8 percent.

直到2000年9月，帕克普莱斯仍否认有关戈德堡计划次年卸任CEO的报道。⁹当被问及健康状况时，这位58岁的赌场大亨简短回应道：“还行。人老了，身体自然会衰退。”¹⁰ 2000年10月19日，戈德堡因骨髓衰竭并发症去世——这显然并非突发状况。更仔细地审视利润情况

<!--en-->
As late as September 2000, Park Place denied a report that Goldberg planned to step down as CEO the following year.⁹ Asked about his health, the 58-year-old casino king tersely replied, "It's okay. Things wear out as you get older."¹⁰ On October 19, 2000, Goldberg died of complications of bone marrow failure—decidedly not a condition that develops suddenly.
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

鉴于戈德堡被誉为“帕克普莱斯娱乐公司的幕后推手，他仅用十年时间就将一家濒临倒闭的赌场公司打造成行业巨头”¹¹，股市对其去世的反应令人意外。尽管股价最初有所下跌，但最终当天仍上涨了0.25个百分点。分析师将股价的韧性归因于戈德堡成功组建了一支强大的管理团队。不过，那些在1999年戈德堡住院期间依赖公司披露信息、却忽视其可能患致命疾病传闻的投资者，未能利用那些最终被证明正确的信息来获利。

<!--en-->
The stock market's reaction to Goldberg's death was surprising, in view of his reputation as "the driving force behind Park Place Entertainment, the man who in just ten years turned a failing casino company into a powerhouse that dominated the industry."¹¹ After dropping initially, the stock finished up a quarter-point on the day. Analysts credited the shares' resilience to Goldberg's success in assembling a strong management team. Be that as it may, investors who relied on the company's disclosures during Goldberg's 1999 hospitalization, while ignoring rumors of a potentially fatal illness, failed to capitalize on information that influenced the stock and ultimately proved to be correct.

帕克普莱斯娱乐公司或许会因延迟披露戈德堡的健康问题而受到批评，但至少其披露时机比太阳城工业公司在类似情况下的处理更为及时。1997年5月29日，这家餐饮服务商极为遗憾地宣布了其总裁古斯塔夫·明金去世的消息。这一关于明金逝世的初步披露是在事件发生后四天进行的。对于注意到高层人事变动往往会影响股票价值的投资者而言，更及时的报告显然是可取的。

<!--en-->
Park Place Entertainment might be criticized for tardiness in divulging Goldberg's health problems, but at least its disclosure was more punctual than that of Sun City Industries under similar circumstances. On May 29, 1997, the food-service distributor announced with deepest regret the death of its president, Gustave Minkin. This initial disclosure of Minkin's passing came four days after the event. For investors who have noticed that senior-level personnel changes often affect the value of a stock, somewhat prompter reporting is desirable.

### 审计中的系统性问题

<!--en-->
*SYSTEMATIC PROBLEMS IN AUDITING*

没有任何一种审计公司账目的系统能够完美运作。会计准则的更新必然滞后于催生新型交易的企业创新，这就给了企业在报表编制上可乘之机。事实上，企业会投入大量精力专门寻找现有准则中的灰色地带和漏洞。此外，即便是最清晰的会计规则，也无法完全保护财务报表使用者免受违反规则的企业高管的影响。遗憾的是，最受尊敬的审计事务所中难免会有少数害群之马（即那些愿意收受贿赂以协助管理层歪曲事实、而不履行保护财务报表使用者职责的人）。与其他类型的犯罪一样，政府很难投入足够资源进行执法，从而通过确保作案者几乎必定会被抓到的方式来震慑潜在违法者。

<!--en-->
No system for auditing companies' books will ever work perfectly. Updating of accounting standards will inevitably lag business innovations that generate new types of transactions, giving companies leeway in how they are to be reported. Indeed, companies devote vast energy specifically to finding gray areas and loopholes in existing standards. Moreover, even crystal-clear accounting rules cannot fully protect the users of financial statements from corporate executives who violate them. Regrettably, the most respected auditing firms are bound to have a few bad apples (i.e., individuals willing to accept bribes to facilitate management's misrepresentations rather than faithfully fulfill their role as protectors of financial statement users). As with other types of crime, it is not feasible for the government to devote enough resources to law enforcement to deter would-be perpetrators through near certainty of getting caught.

然而，声称无法设计出完美的系统，与认为现行财务会计准则制定、审计及反欺诈监管机制已经达到了现实条件允许的最佳水平，完全是两码事。现行体系并非由纯粹出于向公众提供准确透明财务报表愿望的专家小组通过客观分析而制定的产物。

<!--en-->
To say that no perfect system can be designed, however, is quite different from saying that existing provisions for issuing financial accounting standards, conducting audits, and policing fraud are as good as real-world conditions permit. The present system is not the product of objective analysis by panels of experts driven solely by a desire to provide accurate and transparent financial statements to the public.

恰恰相反，规则制定机构的设计及其发布的规则，都是激烈政治斗争的结果。审计事务所属于追求利润最大化的企业，它们面临着维护职业标准与留住客户、控制成本之间的不可避免冲突。基于这些事实，个别的审计失败案例不能被视为孤立事件。尽管针对极其触目惊心的会计丑闻会定期出台改革措施，但系统性因素仍在持续导致财务信息失真。

<!--en-->
On the contrary, the design of the rule-making bodies and the rules they issue are outcomes of fiercepolitical struggles. Auditing firms are profit-maximizing businesses that face unavoidable conflicts between upholding professional standards, on the one hand, and retaining clients and controlling costs, on the other. Given these facts, individual cases of audit failure cannot be viewed as isolated incidents. A systematic component perpetuates financial misreporting, despite reforms that periodically emerge in reaction to exceptionally shocking accounting scandals.

信息披露与审计的可靠性 185

<!--en-->
The Reliability of Disclosure and Audits
185

该系统对2001–2002年间涉及安然、环球电讯、泰科国际和世界通信等知名企业的财务报告重大丑闻的反应，恰恰说明了问题的顽固性。会计行业的批评者指出了多年来在向同一客户提供审计服务与销售咨询服务之间日益加剧的利益冲突。他们问道：如果公司管理层能用丰厚的咨询合同作为诱饵迫使审计师让步，那么审计师还可能在会计政策争议中坚持己见吗？

<!--en-->
The system's response to the financial reporting megascandals of 2001–2002, involving prominent companies such as Enron, Global Crossing, Tyco International, and WorldCom, illustrates the intractability of the problem. Critics of the accounting profession highlighted the conflict of interest that had grown over the years between the provision of audits and the sale of consulting services to the same clients. Was an auditor likely to stand firm in a dispute over accounting policy, they asked, if the company's management could dangle lucrative consulting contracts as an inducement to back down?

科技股崩盘后的会计丑闻引发了公众的强烈不满，从而推动了消除审计与咨询业务冲突的政治势头。然而，《华尔街日报》对构成道琼斯工业平均指数的公司进行的分析发现：在证券交易委员会开始打击这种做法两年后，支付给审计师的费用中仍有62%用于非审计服务；而且，这一比例较上一年（2001年）的75%的降幅被夸大了。关于审计师独立性的新规定扩大了可被视为审计费用范畴的定义。从非审计服务重新归类为审计服务的项目包括法定审计、提交给证券交易委员会的文件审查，以及为符合公认审计准则而进行的税务和会计咨询。在某种程度上，审计相关费用占总费用比例的相对下降，也反映出审计成本每年平均上涨10%至15%；这种上涨源于会计准则复杂性的增加以及处理衍生品合约所需专业人员的增多。

<!--en-->
Popular outrage over the post–Tech Wreck accounting scandals created political momentum to eliminate the auditing-consulting conflict. A *Wall Street Journal* analysis of the companies constituting the Dow Jones Industrial Average¹² found, however, that two years after the Securities and Exchange Commission began to crack down on the practice, 62 percent of fees paid to auditors were for nonauditing services. Furthermore, the decline from 75 percent in the preceding year (2001) was overstated. The new rules on auditor independence expanded the definition of what could be considered part of the audit fee. Services that were reclassified from nonauditing to auditing included statutory audits, reviews of documents filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, and consultations on taxes and accounting to the extent they were needed to comply with generally accepted auditing standards. To some extent as well, the relative decline in the auditing-related portion of total fees reflected an average 10 percent to 15 percent year-over-year increase in the cost of audits, reflecting the increased complexity of accounting standards and expanded use of specialists to deal with derivatives contracts.

据美国消费者联合会投资者保护部主任芭芭拉·罗珀称：“实际上什么都没改变，只是表面上看冲突似乎减少了。”对2001–2002年会计丑闻的应对方式，恰恰说明了上市公司及其审计师的游说团体如何阻碍更彻底的改革。像特许金融分析师协会这样的财务报表使用者倡导者，在企业和审计利益集团面前显得势单力薄。这些团体投入大量资源参与听证会及意见征集活动，以影响财务会计准则委员会和证券交易委员会的决策。随着改革进程拖延，公众对会计问题的愤怒往往会逐渐消退，因为他们的注意力会转移到立法和监管领域的其他新争议上。一旦人们对会计系统改革的关注减弱，企业和审计师的持续游说便会使原本全面的改革提案大打折扣。**深入剖析利润问题**

<!--en-->
According to Barbara Roper, director of investor protection at the Consumer Federation of America, “The conflict looks less without anything having changed.”¹³
The response to the 2001–2002 accounting scandals illustrates the way lobbyists for reporting companies and their auditors can block more thoroughgoing reforms. Advocates for the users of financial statements, such as the Chartered Financial Analysts Institute, are outgunned by corporate and auditing interests. Those groups commit substantial resources to participating in hearings and requests for comments that influence the deliberations of the Financial Accounting Standards Board and the SEC. As the reformprocess drags on, popular anger over accounting issues tends to subside, as the public's attention shifts to new controversies in other areas of legislation and regulation. With attention diverted from reform of the accounting system, persistent lobbying by corporations and auditors waters down the original sweeping proposals.
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

审计过程中的系统性问题不仅源于监管结构，也源于追求利润最大化的会计师事务所的商业策略。这一问题可追溯至20世纪70年代，当时美国注册会计师协会解除了对审计师刊登广告、主动招揽竞争对手客户以及参与竞标业务的禁令。

<!--en-->
Systematic problems in the audit process arise not only from the regulatory structure but also from the business strategies of profit-maximizing accounting firms.¹⁴ The problem dates back to the 1970s, when the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants lifted a ban on auditors advertising their services, soliciting rival firms' clients unless invited, and participating in competitive bids for business.

这一变化源于联邦政府对行业内此类规定的打击——政府认为它们具有反竞争性，并威胁要提起反垄断诉讼予以废除。由此引发了竞价战；久而久之，审计便成了会计师事务所为争夺利润更丰厚的咨询业务而低价提供的服务。审计越来越多地采用固定收费模式，这迫使事务所必须严格控制成本。在压缩审计工时的压力下，事务所往往无法投入必要资源来发现不当报告行为。

<!--en-->
This change resulted from a federal government crackdown on such rules within professions, deeming them anticompetitive and threatening to launch antitrust suits to abolish them. Bidding wars resulted, and over time, audits became a service that accounting firms offered at a knockdown rate to compete for the more profitable consulting business. Increasingly, auditing was offered at a flat fee, making it imperative to hold down costs. Under pressure to limit the hours devoted to an audit, firms were not consistently able to devote the resources needed to uncover improper reporting.

20世纪90年代，基于风险的审计应运而生，旨在控制成本。事务所放弃了以往逐一审查财务报表所有组成部分的传统做法。他们不再专注于单个交易的细节，而是识别出他们认为出错或舞弊风险最高的领域，比如复杂的衍生品。令人难以置信的是，在某些情况下，这些判断竟是基于管理层的建议做出的。例如，安永会计师事务所审计HealthSouth公司2002年度账目时（详见第11章对该公司大规模会计欺诈的描述），审计团队询问公司高管是否知晓任何重大舞弊行为，高管们自然回答“没有”。

<!--en-->
In the 1990s, risk-based audits emerged as a means of keeping a lid on costs. Firms abandoned their traditional bottom-up approach of examining all components of the financial statements. Instead of focusing on details of individual transactions, they identified the areas that in their judgment presented the greatest risk of error or fraud, such as complex derivatives. Incredibly, these judgments in some cases were based on management's advice. For instance, when Ernst & Young audited the 2002 accounts of HealthSouth (see Chapter 11 for details of that company's massive accounting fraud), the audit team asked the company's executives whether they were aware of any significant instances of fraud, to which the executives naturally answered no.

审计师接受了管理层的说法，因为他们认为HealthSouth的管理层品行端正，其财务数据生成系统可靠。基于此，安永审计团队对HealthSouth数据的测试次数，远远少于他们对那些被认为存在较高不当会计风险的公司所进行的测试次数。

<!--en-->
The auditors accepted management's assertion on the grounds that they considered HealthSouth's management ethical and its system for generating financial data reliable. On that basis, the Ernst & Young audit team performed many fewer tests of HealthSouth's numbers than they would have at a company they deemed to have a higher risk of improper accounting.

向基于风险的审计模式转变所带来的负面影响，在电信巨头世通公司的会计欺诈案中同样显而易见。2002年的一段时期内，投资者严重怀疑任何公司的财务报表是否可靠——毕竟根据安达信会计师事务所的说法，世通公司的报表是按照公认会计原则（GAAP）编制的，但其背后却隐藏着巨大的猫腻。最终，世通公司虚增了106亿美元的利润，并于2002年成为当时规模最大的企业破产案。

<!--en-->
The detrimental impact of the shift toward risk-based audits was also apparent in the accounting fraud of telecommunications giant WorldCom. For a period during 2002, investors seriously wondered if any company's financial statements were reliable, considering what lay beneath the WorldCom financials that, according to Arthur Andersen, were prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP). All told, WorldCom racked up $10.6 billion of fraudulent profits on the way to becoming, in 2002, the largest corporate bankruptcy up to that time.

信息披露与审计的可靠性 187

<!--en-->
The Reliability of Disclosure and Audits
187

在世通公司初创时期，安达信会计师事务所以细致入微、自下而上的方式对其进行审计。他们审查了数千笔交易，并确认这些交易已准确记录在公司的总账中。然而随着公司规模的扩大，安达信逐渐转向基于风险的审计流程。

<!--en-->
In WorldCom's early days, Arthur Andersen audited the company in a meticulous, bottom-up way. It reviewed thousands of individual transactions and confirmed them in the company's general ledger. As the company grew, however, Andersen migrated toward a risk-based process.

审计人员利用先进的软件来分析世通公司的财务报表，并开会讨论管理层可能操纵数字的手段。一旦识别出高风险领域，他们便通过询问员工、进行抽样测试等方式来评估内部控制的有效性，以确定相关程序是否得到执行。

<!--en-->
The auditors used sophisticated software to analyze WorldCom's statements and met to brainstorm about ways in which management might be fudging the numbers. Once they identified an area of high risk, they assessed the adequacy of the internal controls by reviewing procedures with employees and running sample tests to determine whether the procedures were being followed.

一旦对控制措施或程序产生疑问，安达信便依赖管理层提供的答案。这存在两个问题：首先，安达信的软件早已将世通公司标记为高风险客户；其次，安达信与世通管理层之间的关系并不利于提出尖锐质疑或对答案持怀疑态度。在2000年的审计提案中，安达信自称是“[世通公司]团队中尽职尽责的一员”¹⁵。试想一下，一名足球裁判竟称自己为所执裁比赛中的“球队成员”！

<!--en-->
If a question arose about controls or procedures, Andersen relied on the answers provided by management. This was problematic for two reasons. First, Andersen's software had identified WorldCom as a maximum-risk client. Second, the relationship between Andersen and WorldCom's management was not conducive to asking tough questions or being skeptical about the answers. In its proposal to the company for the 2000 audit, Andersen characterized itself as "a committed member of [WorldCom's] team."¹⁵ Imagine a football referee calling himself a member of a team in a game at which he was officiating!

安达信的审计人员经常询问世通公司管理人员是否进行了任何异常的账外调整（即季度结账后录入总账的会计分录）。高管们始终否认有此类行为；而根据公司破产审查员的报告，安达信并未采取任何测试来核实他们的说法。

<!--en-->
Andersen's auditors regularly asked WorldCom managers whether they had made any unusual top-side adjustments (i.e., general ledger accounting entries that were recorded after the books had closed for the quarter). The executives consistently replied that they had not, and according to a report by the company's bankruptcy examiner, Andersen did no tests to confirm their claims.

作为所谓的防范措施，审计人员会留意世通公司合并资产负债表中的大幅波动。由于未发现异常，他们便认为无需进一步核查。但事实证明，管理层正是刻意操纵报表以避免出现异常差异。世通公司的账外调整将负债逆转，并把费用重新归类为资产，以此推迟成本的确认。如果安达信的审计人员采用传统方式深入核查具体的会计分录，他们就会发现有数百笔数字整齐、毫无佐证材料的可疑分录。其中一笔金额为2.39亿美元、发生在季度末的分录，仅由一张写着“$239,000,000”的便签纸作为凭证。

<!--en-->
As a supposed safeguard, the auditors looked for large swings in items on WorldCom's consolidated balance sheet. Finding none, they concluded that no follow-up procedures were needed. As it turned out, however, management had manipulated the statements precisely to ensure that there would be no unusual variances. WorldCom's top-side adjustments reversed liabilities and reclassified expenses as assets to delay the recognition of costs. If Andersen's people had drilled down to specific journal entries in the old-fashioned way, they would have discovered hundreds of large entries of suspiciously round numbers and no supporting documentation. One post-quarter-end entry for $239 million was documented solely by a sticky note showing the number "$239,000,000."

然而，若要逐一核查此类项目，将会增加对世通公司审计的成本。鉴于安达信在该公司审计上的支出已超过其收费金额，它并不愿意承担这笔额外费用。受竞争压力所迫，这项审计成了安达信用来从世通公司获取盈利性咨询业务的“亏本促销品”。

<!--en-->
Going to the trouble of checking such items, however, would have added to the cost of auditing WorldCom. That was not something Arthur Andersen was keen on, given that it had already spent more on the company's audit than it had billed. As a result of competitive pressures, the audit had become a loss leader that Andersen used to obtain profitable consulting business from WorldCom.

对成本的过度控制同样制约了审计人员对财务报表使用者——美国证券交易委员会的保护作用。¹⁶国会吝于为SEC审查10-K、10-Q以及首次公开募股招股说明书等文件的工作提供资金。

<!--en-->
Obsessive cost control similarly hamstrung the auditors' backup to protecting users of financial statements, the Securities and ExchangeCommission.¹⁶ Congress was stingy in funding the SEC's efforts to check filings such as 10-Ks, 10-Qs, and initial public offering prospectuses.

1981年至2001年间，该委员会公司金融部需要审核的文件数量增长了81%，但工作人员仅增加了29%。管理咨询公司麦肯锡的报告指出，为了完成文件审核的数量指标，不堪重负的公司金融部员工便钻制度的空子，专门挑选较小且易于审核的文件，而回避复杂的文件。此外，对数量的过分强调也阻碍了监管人员行使要求更深入审查的权力。SEC资金短缺的另一个迹象是人员流失——其薪资水平已落后于私营部门。1999年和2000年，SEC人员的离职率是联邦政府平均水平的两倍。更仔细地审视利润问题

<!--en-->
Between 1981 and 2001, the number of filings that the commission's Corporation Finance Division was called on to review grew by 81 percent, but the staff expanded by only 29 percent. A report by management consultant McKinsey & Co. found that to meet numerical targets for reviewing filings, the overstretched Corporation Finance employees gamed the system, selecting smaller, easy-to-review filings and avoiding more complex ones. Furthermore, the emphasis on volume deterred the surveillance people from exercising their option of ordering deeper reviews. A further indication of tightfistedness in funding the SEC was loss of staff, as salaries fell behind private-sector pay levels. In 1999 and 2000, SEC personnel quit at twice the average rate within the federal government.
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

国会不愿向美国证监会提供其履行职责所需的资源，这背后反映的不仅仅是联邦预算分配上的竞争。从意识形态角度看，许多国会议员反对对商业活动实施严格管控。这种态度的一种体现是1995年提出的一项提案：将美国证监会的预算冻结五年；将委员人数从五人削减至三人；并要求该机构为任何监管变更的成本提供理由。

<!--en-->
Congress's unwillingness to give the SEC the resources it needed to do its job reflected more than competing claims on the federal budget. From an ideological standpoint, many members of Congress opposed strict controls on business. One manifestation of this attitude was a 1995 proposal for a five-year freeze on the SEC's budget, a cutback in the number of commissioners from five to three, and a requirement that the agency justify the cost of any regulatory change.

幸运的是，财务报表使用者们没有受到这些提议的影响。2000年10月，美国证监会主席亚瑟·莱维特与执法主管理查德·沃克出示了相关证据，表明审计师们宁愿对会计违规行为视而不见，也不愿冒险失去利润丰厚的咨询业务。莱维特希望限制事务所为同一客户同时提供审计和咨询服务的能力，但参议院银行委员会主席菲尔·格拉姆却称这一计划“过于严苛”。¹⁷最终，美国证监会只能满足于要求企业披露其支付给审计师的咨询费用数额。

<!--en-->
Fortunately for users of financial statements, these proposals were not accepted. In October 2000, SEC Chairman Arthur Levitt and enforcement chief Richard Walker presented evidence of auditors agreeing to turn a blind eye to accounting irregularities rather than risk losing profitable consulting business. Levitt wanted to restrict firms' ability to provide auditing and consulting to the same clients, but Senate Banking Committee Chairman Phil Gramm denounced the plan as "too draconian."¹⁷ The SEC had to settle for merely requiring companies to disclose the amounts they paid auditors for consulting work.

前美国证监会首席会计师林恩·特纳指出，来自国会的持续打压影响了该委员会的议程与改革进程。此外，国会对财政支出的严格控制也对基层执法工作产生了负面影响。1991年至2001年间，执法部门受理的案件数量增长了65%，而工作人员仅增加了27%。据前美国证监会官员理查德·索尔称，资源过于紧张，以至于没有时间主动去发现新的违规行为。当时已经存在大量明显构成违规的事项积压未处理。这些限制向企业管理层传递了一个信号：作弊行为很可能不会被察觉。

<!--en-->
Lynn Turner, former chief accountant at the SEC, said that the relentless assault from Congress affected the commission's agenda and reforms. In addition, Congress's tight rein on the purse strings had an adverse effect at the ground level of enforcement. Between 1991 and 2001, the cases opened by the Enforcement Division grew by 65 percent while the staff expanded by only 27 percent. According to former SEC official Richard Sauer, resources were too stretched to leave time to prospect for new infractions. There was already a backlog of items that clearly constituted violations. These constraints signaled to corporate management that there was a good chance that cheating would go undetected.

作为国会吝啬作风影响的一个例证，1999年执法人员根据一份投资简报中的线索，对泰科国际公司的财务造假行为展开了调查（详见第10章）。应索要文件的要求，泰科公司提交了一些被涂黑页面的文档，这些页面涉及董事长丹尼斯·科兹洛夫斯基通过员工贷款计划借款的情况；公司称这些信息与美国证监会的要求无关。后来查明，科兹洛夫斯基实际上将贷款广泛用于个人开支，尽管该计划本意是帮助高管支付股票授予所产生的税款。由于担心更广泛的调查会消耗他们有限的资源，美国证监会人员并未质疑这些涂黑内容，也未要求查看完整的公司账本。他们最终终止了调查且未采取任何行动。后来纽约州检察官指控科兹洛夫斯基从泰科公司挪用了6亿美元。

<!--en-->
As a demonstration of the impact of Congress's frugality, in 1999, the enforcement staff followed up on an investment newsletter tip regarding financial misreporting at Tyco International (see Chapter 10). Responding to a request for documents, Tyco submitted pages that blacked out entriesrelated to Chairman Dennis Kozlowski's borrowings under an employee loan program, saying those items were irrelevant to the SEC's request. It later turned out that Kozlowski had borrowed extensively for personal expenses, even though the program was intended to help executives cover taxes on stock grants. Fearful that a wider probe would absorb too much of their limited resources, SEC personnel did not question the blackouts or request the full company ledger. They shut down their investigation with no action. New York State prosecutors later charged Kozlowski with looting $600 million from Tyco.

信息披露与审计的可靠性 189

<!--en-->
The Reliability of Disclosure and Audits
189

对公司财务报表使用者而言，最后一道防线是其董事会中的审计委员会。多年来，这种保护措施并未被证明是万无一失的。美国证监会在对1987年至1997年间曝光的财务欺诈案件进行研究后发现，涉案公司的审计委员会每年仅召开一次或少数几次会议。

<!--en-->
One final line of defense for users of a company's financial statements is the audit committee of its board of directors. This protection has not proven infallible over the years. In a study of financial frauds that came to light between 1987 and 1997, the Securities and Exchange Commission found that the audit committees of many of the companies involved met only once a year or so.

有些公司甚至根本没有设立审计委员会。近年来为数不多的令人欣慰之举是，美国证监会要求审计委员会成员具备一定的金融知识。这一标准看似显而易见、无需专门立法规定，但读者应当记住：前橄榄球明星、被判有罪的持械抢劫犯O.J.辛普森曾担任Infinity Broadcasting Corporation公司的审计委员会成员。¹⁸

<!--en-->
Some had no audit committees. In one of the few encouraging notes of recent years, the SEC has imposed a financial literacy requirement on audit committee members. This might seem too obvious a criterion to necessitate a specific regulation, but readers should bear in mind that former football star and convicted armed robber O. J. Simpson once served on the audit committee of Infinity Broadcasting Corporation.¹⁸

## 结论

<!--en-->
*CONCLUSION*

如果本章所述的可怕案例只是孤立事件，那么或许可以认为：在大多数情况下，企业披露要求、外部审计以及监管支持共同作用，能够确保财务报表具有较高的可靠性；用户对这些报表进行细致分析似乎也就显得多余。然而，许多公司在信息提供上要么吝啬敷衍，要么在表述方式上玩弄技巧。审计师通常不会直接强制执行会计准则（或GAAP），而是倾向于与管理层协商，以达成一种他们自己能接受的“最低限度合规”状态。采取更强硬立场未必能换来更充分的信息披露，反而可能导致审计合同被转交给另一家政策更为宽松的事务所。鉴于财务报告领域理论与实践之间存在的差距，财务报表使用者必须通过严格的审查来为自己增添一层保护。

<!--en-->
If the horror stories recounted in this chapter were isolated incidents, it might be valid to argue that in most cases, the combined impact of corporate disclosure requirements, external audits, and regulatory backup ensures a high level of reliability in financial statements. Intense analysis of the statements by the users would then seem superfluous. Many companies, however, are either stingy with information or slippery about the way they present it. Rather than laying down the law (or GAAP), auditors typically wind up negotiating with management to arrive at a point where they can convince themselves that the bare minimum requirements of good practice have been satisfied. Taking a harder line may not produce fuller disclosure for investors but merely mean sacrificing the auditing contract to another firm with a more accommodating policy. Given the observed gap between theory and practice in financial reporting, users of financial statements must provide themselves with an additional layer of protection through tough scrutiny of the numbers.

第10章

<!--en-->
CHAPTER 10

### 并购会计

<!--en-->
*Mergers-and-Acquisitions Accounting*

并购或收购的会计处理不会影响合并后公司的后续竞争力或现金生成能力。然而，并购活动中的选择性会计处理方式却可能对报告收益产生重大影响。故意模糊的会计处理手段会让财务报告使用者难以判断：一家频繁进行收购的公司究竟是在实现**内生性增长**，还是通过无法创造经济效益的业务组合来制造繁荣假象？

<!--en-->
The accounting treatment of a merger or acquisition does not affect the combined companies' subsequent competitive strength or ability to generate cash. Discretionary accounting choices in mergers-and-acquisitions (M&A) activity can, however, have a substantial impact on reported earnings. Intentionally opaque accounting makes it difficult for users of financial reporting to tell whether a highly acquisitive company is achieving **organic growth** or creating an illusion of dynamism through business combinations that generate no economic benefits.

### 最大化收购后的报告收益

<!--en-->
*MAXIMIZING POSTACQUISITION REPORTED EARNINGS*

在1998年收购美国外科器械公司（United States Surgical）的交易中，企业集团泰科国际（Tyco International）想出了一个巧妙的办法来美化收购后的业绩表现。在与泰科完成交易前，被收购方进行了1.9亿美元的资产减值处理，从而减少了未来的折旧费用，进而推高了未来收益。不过，美国外科器械公司在完成减值处理后便不再公布任何财务报表，因此资产价值的减少从未向投资者披露。在著名空头投资者詹姆斯·查诺斯（James Chanos）提醒记者弗洛伊德·诺里斯（Floyd Norris）注意这一问题后，泰科的首席财务官提供了比《纽约时报》专栏作家从美国证券交易委员会（SEC）文件中获取到的更多细节。诺里斯评论称，这一未披露的减值处理意义重大，它揭示了泰科在改善所收购公司运营方面的真实情况。¹ 要促使旗下子公司取得更好业绩并非易事，因为泰科的业务遍布医疗用品、租赁、家庭安防及火灾报警系统、海底电缆以及电子元件等多个领域。（该公司与玩具制造商泰科并无关联。）更仔细地审视利润情况……

<!--en-->
The conglomerate Tyco International devised an ingenious means of dressing up postacquisition performance in its 1998 acquisition of United States Surgical. Shortly before closing its deal with Tyco, the acquiree took a $190 million write-off, reducing future depreciation charges and thereby boosting future earnings. United States Surgical filed no further financial statements after taking the write-off, however. The reduction in asset values was consequently never reported to investors. After the renowned short seller James Chanos drew journalist Floyd Norris's attention to the issue, Tyco's chief financial officer provided more details than the *New York Times* columnist had managed to back out of Tyco's Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filings. Norris commented that the unreported write-off was significant for the light it shed on Tyco's reputation for improving the operations of companies it acquired.¹ Legitimately spurring its subsidiaries to greater achievements was no easy task, with operations scattered across such diverse businesses as medical supplies, leasing, home-security andfire-alarm systems, underwater cable, and electronic components. (The company had no connection with toy manufacturer Tyco.)
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

1999年，大卫·W·泰斯联合公司（David W. Tice Associates）的阿尔伯特·迈耶（Albert Meyer）帮助外界注意到泰科存在可疑的并购会计处理方式。

<!--en-->
Helping to draw attention to Tyco's questionable M&A accounting in 1999 was Albert Meyer of David W. Tice Associates.

在一份长达九页的详细报告中，迈耶指出该公司在多次收购后计提了大量一次性费用。“除非你相信所有这些重组费用毫无意义，否则就无法认为该公司真的在以两位数的速度增长。”² 迈耶强调他并非指责泰科欺诈，而只是批评其激进的会计处理方式。尽管如此，这家多元化制造商还是以典型的方式回应了针对其复杂财务报告的批评：泰科愤怒地谴责迈耶的报告，称“有关该公司的传言是虚假、毫无根据且恶意的”。董事长丹尼斯·科兹洛夫斯基（Dennis Kozlowski）在电话会议上坚称，泰科的财务报表“没有重述、没有违规行为，也没有受到调查”³。不出所料，泰科还得到了华尔街证券分析师的道德支持，几乎所有分析师都对该股给出了“买入”建议。一家领先券商的分析师表示，听完泰科的电话会议后，“我们确信不存在会计问题”⁴。然而，美国证券交易委员会并不认同这一观点。1999年12月9日，泰科披露称，证监会已对过去六年间与该公司的120宗收购相关的特殊费用和准备金计提启动了非正式调查。

<!--en-->
In a detailed, nine-page report, Meyer highlighted the large number of one-time charges taken by the company after many acquisitions. "You have to believe all these restructuring charges have no meaning to believe this thing is really growing at double-digit rates."²
Meyer emphasized that he was not accusing Tyco of fraud, but merely of aggressive accounting. Nevertheless, the diversified manufacturer responded in the classic manner of a company criticized for tricky financial reporting. Tyco angrily denounced Meyer's report, stating that "rumors relating to the company are false, unfounded, and malicious." Chairman Dennis Kozlowski insisted in a conference call that there were "no restatements, no irregularities, and no investigations" involving Tyco's financial statements.³ Predictably, as well, Tyco received moral support from Wall Street securities analysts, almost all of whom had buy recommendations on the stock. An analyst from one of the leading firms said that as a result of hearing Tyco's conference call, "we were convinced there are no accounting issues."⁴
The Securities and Exchange Commission, however, was not convinced. On December 9, 1999, Tyco disclosed that the securities watchdog had launched an informal inquiry into special charges and reserves taken in connection with 120 acquisitions over the preceding six years.

消息公布后，泰科的股价暴跌了23%。该公司仍坚称对其财务报告的批评毫无根据。另一家华尔街领先券商的分析师也附和道：“虽然此次调查给该股前景蒙上阴影，但我们相信证监会会认定其会计政策并无问题，从而平息所有传言和指责。”⁵ 后来，这名分析师因与泰科的科兹洛夫斯基关系过于密切，以及发布含有误导性陈述和夸大之词的研究报告等行为，被其所在公司解雇，并被美国证券交易商协会处以罚款。为泰科的财务报告辩护的人不止他一个。一位自称长期跟踪该公司会计状况的知名分析师将查诺斯和迈耶提出的问题斥为“虚假信息”和“无稽之谈”。不过，在迈耶的报告发布后的几周内，泰科股价累计下跌近50%，这让一些原本力挺该公司的分析师感到紧张。“我们大多数人还好，”一位分析师开玩笑说，“只有少数人需要接受自杀干预。”⁶ 2000年6月26日公布的证监会调查结果证明，并无必要采取如此极端的举动。

<!--en-->
Tyco's share price plummeted by 23 percent on the news. The company continued to insist that the criticisms of its financial reporting were all unfounded. Another leading Wall Street firm's analyst chimed in: "While this investigation puts a further cloud on the stock, we believe that the company will receive a clean bill of health from the SEC regarding its accounting policies, which could put an end to all the rumors and accusations."⁵
This analyst was later fired by his firm and fined by the National Association of Securities Dealers for such misdeeds as being excessively chummy with Tyco's Kozlowski and publishing research reports containing misleading statements and exaggerated claims. He was not alone in defending Tyco's financial reporting. One prominent analyst, who claimed to have followed the company's accounting closely, dismissed the issues raised by Chanos and Meyer as "bogus" and nothing but "noise." Still, a nearly 50 percent cumulative drop in Tyco's stock in the weeks following Meyer's report made some of the company's sell-side boosters nervous. "Most of us are doing fine," joked one analyst, "except for a few who are on suicide watch."⁶
No such desperate acts were warranted by the outcome of the SEC inquiry, announced on June 26, 2000.

泰科公司被要求重新陈述财务业绩，以冲销那些委员会认为根本不应设立或应更早冲销的合并储备金。但此次重述仅将每股0.02美元的金额从一个季度转移到另一个季度而已。消息公布后，泰科股价上涨了13%。一家领先的华尔街公司的会计分析师评论道：“看到这些项目能从美国证监会极为详尽的审查中脱颖而出，足以证明泰科会计实务的诚信度。”⁷ 一家持有约1200万股泰科股票的大型资产管理公司的分析师补充说，美国证监会的调查结果“消除了人们对该公司会计做法及其管理层可信度的任何疑虑。”⁸ 并购会计 193

<!--en-->
Tyco was required to restate its results to reverse merger reserves that the commission said should never have beenset up or should have been reversed earlier, but the restatement shifted a paltry $0.02 a share from one quarter to another. Tyco's stock jumped by 13 percent on the news. A leading Wall Street firm's accounting analyst commented, "To see these items come out of what, by all indications, was an exhaustive SEC review, is a testament to the integrity of Tyco's accounting practices."⁷ An analyst at a prominent money management firm that held about 12 million Tyco shares added that the results of the SEC inquiry "put to rest any lurking fears about the company's accounting and the credibility of its management."⁸
Mergers-and-Acquisitions Accounting
193

尽管如此，关于泰科合并会计的问题仍挥之不去。两年半后，《华尔街日报》报道称，泰科在过去三年中进行了700多笔未公开的收购，花费超过80亿美元，随后其股价下跌了19%。敏锐的分析师早已怀疑背后有猫腻。他们质疑为何在最近一个财年，归属于泰科工业业务的债务竟翻倍至216亿美元，而该公司却报告了48亿美元的**自由现金流**。

<!--en-->
Nevertheless, the issue of Tyco's merger accounting continued to lurk. Two-and-a-half years later, Tyco shares fell by 19 percent after the *Wall Street Journal* reported that the company had spent more than $8 billion in the preceding three years on more than 700 undisclosed acquisitions. Alert analysts had suspected something was going on behind the scenes. They questioned why, in the most recent fiscal year, debt attributable to Tyco's industrial businesses doubled to $21.6 billion even though the company reported $4.8 billion in **free cash flow**.

泰科首席财务官马克·斯沃茨为公司的披露行为辩护称，众多小型收购相对于泰科的庞大规模而言并不具备单独的重要性。这看似符合公认会计原则（GAAP）的字面规定，实则违背了其实质——隐瞒了那些合计起来具有重要性的收购行为。斯沃茨承认，从泰科的财务报表中无法确定用于未披露交易的数额，因为公司是以扣除被收购公司资产负债表上现金后的净额来列报收购支出，且并未披露这些现金的总额。

<!--en-->
Tyco Chief Financial Officer Mark Swartz defended the company's disclosures on the grounds that the numerous small acquisitions were not individually material relative to Tyco's huge size. This was a case of meeting the letter of generally accepted accounting practices (GAAP) but violating the spirit by concealing acquisitions that were collectively material. Swartz acknowledged that the amount spent on unannounced deals was not determinable from Tyco's financial statements because it reported acquisition expenditures net of cash on the acquired companies' balance sheets and did not disclose the aggregate amount of that cash.

当《财富》杂志于2002年4月1日发表文章⁹，指控泰科在1999年收购电子制造商瑞凯姆公司时存在会计造假行为时，外界对泰科收购会计的担忧再度浮现。作为独立公司的最后一年，瑞凯姆报告的盈利为1.79亿美元，低于1997年的2.53亿美元。五位前瑞凯姆财务人员及一位前顾问称，在1999年5月宣布收购协议至同年8月交易完成期间，他们被要求加速支付费用、推迟记录已收款项，并虚增储备金。《财富》杂志刊登了瑞凯姆财务主管拉尔斯·拉尔森于1999年7月30日撰写的备忘录摘录，内容涉及“加速现金流出”。拉尔森写道：“应泰科的要求，瑞凯姆的所有主要站点都将支付所有未付账款，无论它们是否到期。”他接着说，他了解到瑞凯姆的首席财务官已同意这一政策，“尽管我们为此花费的资金对瑞凯姆或泰科而言并无实际益处。”8月3日，拉尔森写道：“此举的目的是应泰科的要求，使‘旧’瑞凯姆的现金流为负，而新公司的现金流则为正。”¹⁰ 利润深度剖析

<!--en-->
Lurking concerns about Tyco's acquisition accounting surfaced again when an April 1, 2002, *Fortune* article⁹ published allegations of deceptive accounting in connection with the 1999 acquisition of electronics manufacturer Raychem. In its last year as an independent company, Raychem reported earnings of $179 million, down from 1997's $253 million. Five former financial employees and a former consultant to Raychem said that between the May 1999 announcement of the deal and the August 1999 closing, they were asked to accelerate payment of expenses, hold back postings of payments received, and overstate reserves. *Fortune* published an excerpt from a July 30, 1999, memo by Raychem Treasurer Lars Larson on the subject of "accelerating cash outflow." Larson wrote, "At Tyco's request, all major Raychem sites will pay all pending payables, whether they are due or not." He went on to say that he understood Raychem's chief financial officer had agreed to the policy, "even though we will be spending the money for no tangible benefit either to Raychem or Tyco." On August 3, Larson wrote, "The purpose of this effort is, at Tyco's request, tocause cash flows to be negative in the ‘old’ Raychem, and more positive in the new company.”¹⁰
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

另外，一家负责管理瑞凯姆存货的外包公司负责人称，收购后泰科对价值500万美元的存货计提了100%的储备金，声称这些存货可能已无使用价值。

<!--en-->
Separately, the head of an outsourcing firm responsible for managing Raychem inventory reported that Tyco took a 100 percent reserve on $5 million of inventory that supposedly might have no remaining useful life following the acquisition.

考虑到这些存货中包含手套和灯泡等可使用多年的物品，该外包公司建议计提30%的储备金，并认为36%的储备金也是合理的。总体来看，查诺斯和迈耶在1999年的判断似乎是正确的，而次年完成的“详尽的美国证监会审查”显然未能彻底查清所有问题。

<!--en-->
Considering that the inventory included such items as gloves and light bulbs, which would have useful lives of many years, the outsourcing firm had recommended a 30 percent reserve, while allowing that a 36 percent reserve would be defensible. All in all, it appeared that Chanos and Meyer had been on the right track in 1999 and that the “exhaustive SEC review” concluded the following year had left some stones unturned.

《财富》杂志曝光此事后两个月，泰科首席执行官科兹洛夫斯基以所谓的个人原因辞职，不过《纽约时报》报道称他正接受刑事调查。消息公布后，泰科股价暴跌20%。美国证监会启动了对泰科财务报表的新一轮调查，调查范围追溯至1999年，并质疑公司在早前的调查中是否隐瞒了重要信息。

<!--en-->
Two months after the *Fortune* exposé appeared, Tyco CEO Kozlowski resigned for the proverbial personal reasons, although the *New York Times* reported that he was under criminal investigation. Tyco’s stock plunged by 20 percent on the news. The SEC opened a new investigation of Tyco’s financial statements, including those as far back as 1999, and questioned whether the company had withheld important information during its earlier probe.

在科兹洛夫斯基的继任者领导下，公司启动了对其过往财务报告的内部审查。调查人员得出结论：泰科反复使用激进但合法的会计手段，包括在收购前压低被收购公司的报告利润，以便在交易完成后第一个季度制造利润激增的假象。

<!--en-->
Under Kozlowski’s successor, the company initiated an internal review of its past financial reporting. The investigators concluded that Tyco repeatedly used aggressive, albeit legal, accounting gimmicks, including depressing the reported profits of acquired companies immediately before acquisition, in order to generate profit surges in the first quarter after closing.

公司高管将此类做法称为“金融工程”，并指示员工“编造理由”来为那些夸大泰科公司账面盈利的会计变更辩护。一份与此相关的文件中有一处手写批注：“我强烈建议绝不要将此写下来！！”¹¹ 《纽约时报》的安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金总结道：

<!--en-->
Company officials referred to such practices as “financial engineering” and ordered employees to “create stories” to justify accounting changes that would hype Tyco’s reported earnings. One document related to these practices included a handwritten notation: “I would strongly recommend Never to put this in writing!!”¹¹ Andrew Ross Sorkin of the *New York Times* concluded:

> *新的泰科公司虽然仍具生存能力，但正如怀疑论者一直认为的那样：它不过是一堆持续盈利却彼此无关、增长缓慢的业务拼凑体……如果没有源源不断的收购活动——以及每次交易完成后泰科人为制造的虚高盈利数据——过去几年让泰科成为热门股票的稳定增长势头便将不复存在。¹² 除了通过压低被收购企业收购前的利润来虚增账面盈利外，泰科的财务报告激进行为还体现在对“自由现金流”这一术语采用非标准定义以扭曲相关数据。泰科在计算ADT安防报警业务的自由现金流时，排除了出售应收账款所得的现金以及购买客户账户所需的支出，反而将后者标记为“收购”。除了这些会计问题外，还有指控称该公司被侵吞了6亿美元资产；这最终导致丹尼斯·科兹洛夫斯基于2005年被定罪，并被判处8年零4个月至25年监禁。他的审判堪称一场闹剧：法庭上播放了一段记录科兹洛夫斯基妻子生日派对的录像，该派对花费200万美元，其中一半由泰科支付；派对上有人身着托加长袍和角斗士服装，还有米开朗基罗《大卫》雕像的冰雕、形状如女性身体的生日蛋糕，以及吉米·巴菲特提供的娱乐表演。至于阿尔伯特·迈耶，他对泰科财务报表的细致分析帮助精明的投资者避免了在该公司股票上的巨大损失；不过，1999年一位泰科股东愤怒地打电话指责他“搞垮了一家好公司”，这多少冲淡了他因勤勉而获得的媒体认可带来的喜悦。¹³ 并购会计 195

<!--en-->
> *The new Tyco, though still viable, is what skeptics always thought it was: a hodgepodge of consistently profitable but unconnected, slow-growth businesses. . . . Without a steady stream of acquisitions—and the artificially inflated earnings boost that Tyco engineered for the first couple of quarters after each deal was completed—the consistent growth that made Tyco a highflying stock in the last couple of years is over.¹²*
Aside from its tricks for boosting reported earnings by holding down acquired companies’ preacquisition profits, Tyco’s financial reporting aggressiveness involved distortion of reported free cash flow through a non-standard definition of the term. Tyco excluded cash received from sales of receivables and cash outlays for the purchase of customer accounts for its ADT security-alarm business, labeling the latter “acquisitions.” Separatefrom the company's assorted accounting issues were charges of looting the company of $600 million, which led to Dennis Kozlowski's 2005 conviction and sentencing to 8 1/3 to 25 years in prison. His trial was a spectacle that featured a videotape of a $2 million birthday party for Kozlowski's wife, half of which was paid for by Tyco, replete with togas and gladiator costumes, an ice sculpture of Michelangelo's *David*, a birthday cake in the shape of a woman's body, and entertainment by Jimmy Buffett. As for Albert Meyer, whose scrutiny of Tyco's financial statements helped attentive investors avoid huge losses in the company's stock, the pleasure of the media recognition he received for his diligence was somewhat offset by an angry call from a Tyco shareholder in 1999, excoriating him for "bringing a good company down."¹³
Mergers-and-Acquisitions Accounting
195

### 管理收购日期并避免重述财务数据

<!--en-->
*MANAGING ACQUISITION DATES AND AVOIDING RESTATEMENTS*

企业已经开发出多种微妙策略，以利用收购会计规则所赋予的自由裁量权。在收购后最大化账面盈利仍是一个关键目标。例如，一种与并购相关的手段就是出于财务报告目的，采用不同于交易实际完成日期的收购日期，而这种做法符合GAAP规定。通常，企业利用这种灵活性是为了简化月底或季末的结账工作。比如，如果收购协议于5月27日达成，收购方可能会从5月31日起就将被收购企业的业绩纳入自身报表。

<!--en-->
Companies have developed a number of subtle strategies for exploiting the discretion afforded by the rules for acquisition accounting. Maximizing reported earnings in the postacquisition period remains a key objective. For example, one M&A-related gambit entails the GAAP-sanctioned use, for financial reporting purposes, of an acquisition date other than the actual date on which a transaction is consummated. Typically, companies use this discretion to simplify closing their books at month- or quarter-end. For example, if an acquisition agreement is completed on May 27, the acquirer may begin reporting the acquired company's results in its own figures as of May 31.

1999年，Navigant Consulting（前身为Metzler Group，与旅游管理公司Navigant International无关）以一种异常激进的方式利用了收购日期的灵活性。这家公用事业咨询公司于9月中旬收购了Penta Advisory Services，却将收购日期定为7月1日。按照购买法会计规则的一般做法，Navigant从收购日期起便将Penta的营收计入自身总额。因此，尽管Penta直到第三季度末才并入公司体系，Navigant的营收在整个第三季度却得到了提升。

<!--en-->
In 1999, Navigant Consulting (formerly known as Metzler Group and unrelated to the travel management company Navigant International) exploited the acquisition date leeway in an unusually aggressive fashion. The utilities consulting company acquired Penta Advisory Services in mid-September, but designated July 1 as the acquisition date. Following standard practice under purchase accounting rules, Navigant included Penta's revenues in its own totals from the acquisition date forward. Navigant's revenue therefore received a boost for the entire third quarter, even though Penta entered the corporate fold only at the tail end of the period.

诚然，涉及的数字并不大：Penta过去12个月的营收约为500万至600万美元，而Navigant在1998年的销售额则为3.48亿美元。不过，美林证券分析师撒切尔·汤普森还是批评管理层将收购日期提前了2个半月。他写道，这种做法比他在类似情况下所见过的任何案例都要激进。¹⁴ 深入剖析利润数据

<!--en-->
To be sure, the numbers involved were small. Penta's trailing-12-months revenues were in the range of $5 million to $6 million, while Navigant's 1998 sales were $348 million. Nevertheless, Merrill Lynch analyst Thatcher Thompson took management to task for shifting the acquisition date by 2 1/2 months. It was a more aggressive approach, he wrote, than he had ever previously observed under comparable circumstances.¹⁴
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

汤普森并非唯一对Navigant的并购会计处理方式持质疑态度的人，尽管当时Navigant在《福布斯》评选的美国最佳小型公司榜单中排名第三。其他批评者则聚焦于管理层对收购业务是否属于“对整体财务结果具有重大影响”这一标准的利用（该标准后来被收紧）。根据美国证券交易委员会的规定，对于被认为规模较小的被收购企业，公司无需重述以往报表以反映其营收和盈利。Navigant自1996年上市以来通过多次中等规模的收购迅速扩张。从单个来看，这些被收购的咨询业务在GAAP下并不重要，但综合起来却对公司的业绩产生了巨大影响。

<!--en-->
Thompson was not the only commentator with qualms about Navigant's merger accounting, notwithstanding its number three ranking, at the time, on the *Forbes* list of Best Small Companies in America. Other critics focused on management's exploitation of the standards (later tightened up) governing the classification of acquisitions as material to overall financial results. Under Securities and Exchange Commission rules, companies did not have to restate previous statements to reflect the revenues and earnings of acquired businesses deemed immaterial in size. Navigant grew rapidly after going public in 1996 by making many moderate-size acquisitions. Individually, the acquired consulting businesses were immaterial under GAAP, but collectively, they had a large impact on the company's results.

《巴伦周刊》的专栏作家巴里·亨德森通过逐季度追踪流通股数量的变化，估算了Navigant公司在1998年最后三个季度的收购交易收入。¹⁵他扣除了因管理层行使股票期权而发行的股份数，以此推算出用于支付收购款项的股份数量。

<!--en-->
*Barron's* columnist Barry Henderson estimated revenues for Navigant's 1998 acquisitions for the final three quarters of 1998 by tracing the increase in shares outstanding, quarter by quarter.¹⁵ He deducted the number of shares representing exercise of management stock options to estimate how many shares were issued to pay for acquisitions.

将这一数字乘以股价，便得出该季度用于收购的估计金额。（为保守起见，这位记者采用了该时期的最低股价。）接着，亨德森用估算出的收购总价除以2.2——这是Navigant公司声称其收购咨询类企业时通常所支付的过去12个月营收倍数。所得结果便是对1998年第二至第四季度所收购的那些看似无关紧要的公司所产生的收入的合理估算。亨德森指出，如果Navigant公司被要求重新列报1998年第一季度财务数据以反映这些交易，其营收将会达到8300万美元至8400万美元，而非原先报告的7900万美元。这将使1999年第一季度的同比营收增长率从分析师普遍宣称的22%降至约16%。

<!--en-->
Multiplying this figure by the share price gave the estimated dollar amount paid for acquisitions during the quarter. (To be conservative, the journalist used the minimum stock price for the period.) Next, Henderson divided the estimated aggregate acquisition price by 2.2, the multiple of trailing-12-months revenue that Navigant said it usually paid for consulting businesses. The answer represented a reasonable estimate of the revenues produced by the supposedly immaterial companies acquired during the second through fourth quarters of 1998. If Navigant had been required to restate its 1998 first-quarter results for these transactions, Henderson concluded, revenue would have been $83 million to $84 million, instead of the $79 million reported. That would have reduced first-quarter 1999 year-over-year revenue growth to around 16 percent from the sexier 22 percent generally cited by securities analysts.

事实证明，投资者对Navigant公司宽松的收购会计处理方式所发出的警示信号做出反应是正确的。11月22日，董事长兼首席执行官罗伯特·P·马赫在压力下辞职，导致Navigant公司股票暴跌48%。公司董事会发现了证据，表明马赫与其他两名高管参与了“不当”的股票购买行为。

<!--en-->
As it turned out, investors were wise to react to the red flag raised by Navigant's liberal accounting for acquisitions. On November 22, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Robert P. Maher resigned under pressure, touching off a 48 percent plunge in Navigant's stock. The company's directors had uncovered evidence that Maher and two other senior officials were involved in “inappropriate” stock purchases.

简而言之，马赫于1999年8月从公司借走了1000万美元，称其用于房地产投资。¹⁶随后，Navigant董事会认为他实际上是将这笔钱提供给了公司企业发展副总裁斯蒂芬·德纳里。德纳里借了同等数额的资金，以28.39美元的价格¹⁷购买了Navigant公司通过换股方式收购的一家公司的前所有者的股票。不久之后，由于Navigant公司聘请财务顾问探讨包括可能的出售在内的战略选项，这些股票价格飙升至54.25美元。¹⁸并购会计 197

<!--en-->
In brief, Maher borrowed $10 million from the company in August 1999, saying it was for a real estate investment.¹⁶ Navigant's board subsequently came to believe that he in fact advanced the funds to Stephen Denari, the company's vice president of corporate development. Denari had borrowed a like amount to purchase Navigant shares at $28.39¹⁷ from the former owner of a company that Navigant had acquired for stock. A short while later, the shares soared to $54.25 when Navigant hired a financial adviser to explore strategic options, including a possible sale of the company.¹⁸
Mergers-and-Acquisitions Accounting
197

## 结论

<!--en-->
*CONCLUSION*

一家热衷于收购的公司即便遵守公认会计原则（GAAP）的界限，也可能呈现出严重误导外部财务报表使用者的盈利记录。Tyco和Navigant的案例表明，以下任何一项都不能保证一家频繁收购的公司没有在财务报告上动手脚：

<!--en-->
A highly acquisitive company can stay within the boundaries of GAAP yet present an earnings record that grossly misleads outside users of its financial statements. The Tyco and Navigant cases show that none of the following constitutes assurance that a serial acquirer is not monkeying around with its financial reporting:

- 该公司被列入商业杂志评选的最佳公司名单。
- 著名的华尔街证券分析师对该公司会计处理的认可，即使该分析师并不跟踪具体公司，而是专门研究会计问题。
- 美国证券交易委员会在对公司财务数据进行详尽审查后，仅发现轻微的会计问题。
- 管理层极力否认自己歪曲了业绩。鉴于这些保障措施并不可靠，财务报表使用者必须对那些报告出惊人但难以解释的盈利增长的公司保持怀疑态度。可疑迹象可能包括异常多的非经常性项目、尽管报告的自由现金流较高却神秘积累的现金；如果被收购公司在收购前是上市公司，那么在交易完成前其盈利出现下滑现象。遗憾的是，许多并购交易产生的这类会计操纵手段，远比真正的协同效应或被收购公司的运营改善要多得多。![Image](https://easylink-easydoc-task.s3.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/public/f58f5bce11754246d7c288ce5e905fb6.png?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Credential=LTAI5t9E8h6okbJxhoCnJXq1%2F20261012%2Fcn-shanghai%2Fs3%2Faws4_request&X-Amz-Date=20261012T065612Z&X-Amz-Expires=3600&X-Amz-SignedHeaders=host&X-Amz-Signature=dc4829aef111b90268ef1872ff1c94642181f049b484ce9504346cb417320603)

<!--en-->
- Inclusion of the corporation in a business magazine's best companies list.
- A vote of confidence in the company's accounting by famous Wall Street securities analysts, even if the analyst does not follow companies but instead concentrates entirely on accounting issues.
- A finding of only minor accounting issues after an exhaustive review of the company's financials by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
- Heated denials by management that it has misrepresented its results.
Recognizing that such safeguards cannot be relied on, users of financial statements must cast a skeptical eye on companies that report remarkable but difficult-to-explain earnings increases. Clues to hanky-panky may include an unusually large number of special items, a mysterious buildup of cash despite large reported free cash flow, and, if an acquired company was a public reporter prior to its acquisition, a drop in earnings just prior to closing. Sadly, many M&A transactions produce more of this sort of accounting trickery than bona fide synergies or operating improvements in the acquired companies.
![Image](https://easylink-easydoc-task.s3.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/public/f58f5bce11754246d7c288ce5e905fb6.png?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Credential=LTAI5t9E8h6okbJxhoCnJXq1%2F20261012%2Fcn-shanghai%2Fs3%2Faws4_request&X-Amz-Date=20261012T065612Z&X-Amz-Expires=3600&X-Amz-SignedHeaders=host&X-Amz-Signature=dc4829aef111b90268ef1872ff1c94642181f049b484ce9504346cb417320603)

## 第11章

<!--en-->
*CHAPTER 11*

# 欺诈行为能被察觉吗？

<!--en-->
*Is Fraud Detectable?*

本章探讨了财务报表分析师面临的最棘手挑战：一家公司不仅曲解规则，而且故意违反规则。通常，审计师也会积极参与欺诈行为，从而削弱了分析师防范欺骗的关键防线。发现重大且明显的财务报告违规行为的分析师，可以避免巨额投资损失，或通过卖空获利；他们在此过程中也能树立自己的声誉。

<!--en-->
This chapter addresses the most difficult challenge to an analyst of financial statements. It is the case of a company that does not merely bend the rules, but intentionally breaks them. Often, the auditor actively participates in the fraud, thereby disabling one of the analyst's key defenses against deception. Analysts who uncover a major, flagrant violation of financial reporting standards can avert huge investment losses or produce large gains through selling short. They also can make their reputations in the process.

讨论从“操纵行为的蛛丝马迹”开始，这是对那些虚报业绩的公司财务报表的系统研究结果。随后是三个欺诈性报告的案例研究，分别涉及Enron、HealthSouth和Parmalat。这些研究揭示了欺诈是如何实施的，同时也探讨了分析师在察觉此类行为方面的成效。

<!--en-->
The discussion begins with “Telltale Signs of Manipulation,” the findings of systematic studies of financial statements of companies that misrepresented their results. Three case studies of fraudulent reporting follow, involving Enron, HealthSouth, and Parmalat. These studies explain how the frauds were perpetrated and also explore the extent to which analysts succeeded in detecting the wrongdoing.

### 操纵行为的蛛丝马迹

<!--en-->
*TELLTALE SIGNS OF MANIPULATION*

前几章中详述的那些激进的会计做法或许算不上诚实典范，但大多数情况下也不会让企业管理者因此入狱。企业有诸多方法可以蒙蔽投资者而不必担心受到法律制裁。不过，有时企业高管会越过界限，触犯法律。

<!--en-->
The aggressive accounting practices detailed in the preceding chapters may not win awards for candor, but neither will most of them land corporate managers in the penitentiary. There are many ways for companies to pull the wool over investors' eyes without fear of legal retribution. Sometimes, however, corporate executives step over the line into illegality.

公然的虚假陈述与单纯利用财务报告漏洞的行为属于截然不同的范畴。此外，此类不当行为的严重性并不仅仅取决于现行法律。1992年，罗马天主教会正式将财务造假列为一种罪行。当年公布的教理问答中，将篡改账目列入所谓“新罪过”之列——即1566年上一次教会教义修订时尚未出现的违法行为。199 深入了解利润

<!--en-->
Outright misrepresentation falls into a category entirely separate from the mere exploitation of financial reporting loopholes. Moreover, the gravity of such misconduct is not solely a matter of temporal law. In 1992, the Roman Catholic Church officially classified fraudulent accounting as a sin. A catechism unveiled in that year listed cooking the books in a series of so-called new transgressions, that is, offenses not known in 1566, the time of the last previous overhaul of church teachings.
199
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

然而，无论是担心被起诉还是顾及精神层面的后果，都不足以完全阻止那些不诚实的财务信息提供者。即便审计是出于善意进行的，有时也未必能发现其中的虚假内容。因此，财务分析师必须努力保护自己，以免遭受欺诈带来的后果。

<!--en-->
Neither fear of prosecution nor concern for spiritual well-being, however, entirely deters dishonest presenters of financial information. Audits, even when conducted in good faith, sometimes fail to uncover dangerous fictions. Financial analysts must therefore strive to protect themselves from the consequences of fraud.

没有任何方法能保证能发现财务报告中的不当行为，但分析师也没有义务将审计师给出的无保留意见视为最终定论。即便没有大型会计师事务所所拥有的资源，也依然有可能找到有关财务报表真实性的重要线索。

<!--en-->
No method is guaranteed to uncover malfeasance in financial reporting, but neither are analysts obliged to accept an auditor's clean opinion as final. Even without the resources that are available to a major accounting firm, it is feasible to find valuable clues about the integrity of financial statements.

印第安纳大学凯利商学院会计与信息系统教授梅索德·丹尼尔·贝尼什，根据财务报表中的数据开发出了一种识别可能操纵盈利企业的模型。¹（贝尼什对“操纵”的定义既包括真正的欺诈行为，也包括在公认会计原则[GAAP]框架内对盈利或披露的人为调节。无论哪种情况，他的定义都要求该企业随后必须根据审计师要求、内部调查或美国证券交易委员会[SEC]的调查而重新编制报表、冲销资产，或更改会计估计或政策。）通过统计分析，贝尼什发现以下五个因素中只要存在任何一个，企业操纵盈利的可能性就会增加：

<!--en-->
Messod Daniel Beneish, professor of accounting and information systems at the Kelley School of Business at Indiana University, has developed a model for identifying companies that are likely to manipulate their earnings, based on numbers reported in their financial statements.¹ (Beneish defines *manipulation* to include both actual fraud and the management of earnings or disclosure within generally accepted accounting practices [GAAP]. In either case, his definition specifies that the company subsequently must have been required to restate results, write off assets, or change its accounting estimates or policies at the behest of its auditors, an internal investigation, or a Securities and Exchange Commission [SEC] probe.) Beneish finds, by statistical analysis, that the presence of any of the following five factors increases the probability of earnings manipulation:

1. 应收账款周转天数增加。
2. 毛利率恶化。
3. 折旧率下降。
4. 资产质量下降（定义为除不动产、厂房及设备以外的非流动资产占总资产比例上升）。
5. 销售额增长。需要注意的是，贝尼什并未将这些指标视为会计不当行为的确凿证据。事实上，如果所有销售增长迅猛的企业都被认定是通过人为手段达到这一结果，那将令人沮丧。不过，贝尼什的数据表明他所列出的现象与盈利操纵之间存在强烈关联。

财务报告操纵的证据也可以在财务报表之外找到。洛克公司治理研究中心发表的一篇论文²重点关注企业高管在季度财报发布时举行的电话会议。斯坦福大学商学院的大卫·F·拉克尔教授和博士候选人阿纳斯塔西娅·A·扎科柳基娜通过分析29,663次电话会议记录中的问答部分，识别出财务报告造假的言语线索。欺诈行为能否被察觉？根据随后重新编制报表的企业情况以及识别严重会计问题的标准，拉克尔和扎科柳基娜将每个问答部分标记为“真实”或“虚假”。他们的方法明显优于随机判断，能够正确分类50%到65%的问答部分。他们还发现，基于首席执行官和首席财务官所用词汇做出的判断，比基于应计项目调整的模型更为准确。与诚实的高管相比，虚假陈述的高管在回答中更多提及常识性内容（如“你懂的”这类表述），较少使用极端正面的情绪词（如“稳健”或“值得称赞”），也较少提及股东价值和创造价值。此外，虚假陈述的首席执行官更少提及自己，而更多使用非个人化的第三方表述，比如“团队”或“公司”，而非“我”。他们使用更极端的正面情绪词（如“棒极了”）和更少的极端负面情绪词，同时使用的确定性词汇和犹豫性词汇也更少。

<!--en-->
1. Increasing days' sales in receivables.
2. Deteriorating gross margins.
3. Decreasing rates of depreciation.
4. Decreasing asset quality (defined as an increase in the ratio of noncurrent assets other than property, plant, and equipment to total assets).
5. Growing sales.
Note that Beneish does not characterize these indicators as irrefutable evidence of accounting malfeasance. Indeed, it would be disheartening if every company registering high sales growth were shown to be achieving its results artificially. Nevertheless, Beneish's data suggest a strong association between the phenomena he lists and earnings manipulation.
Evidence of financial reporting manipulation can also be found outside the financial statements. A paper published by the Rock Center for Corporate Governance² focuses on the conference calls that corporate senior executives make in connection with quarterly earnings releases. Professor David F. Larcker and doctoral candidate Anastasia A. Zakolyukina of the Stanford Graduate School of Business identified verbal cues of financial reporting hanky-panky by analyzing the question-and-answer sections of the transcripts of 29,663 conference calls.
Is Fraud Detectable?
Based on which companies subsequently restated their results, as well as a set of criteria for identifying especially serious accounting problems, Larcker and Zakolyukina label each Q&A section “truthful” or “deceptive.” Their methodology is significantly better than random, classifying 50 percent to 65 percent of the Q&A sections correctly. They also find that judgments based on the words used by chief executive officers and chief financial officers are more accurate than a model based on discretionary accruals.
Relative to the answers given by truthful executives, the replies of deceptive executives contain more references to general knowledge (such as the phrase “you know”), fewer nonextreme positive emotions (“solid” or “respectable”), and fewer references to shareholder value and creating value. Furthermore, deceptive CEOs make fewer references to themselves and more to impersonal third parties, saying “the team” or “the company,” rather than “I.” They use more extreme positive emotions (“fantastic,” for example) and fewer extreme negative emotions, as well as fewer certainty and hesitation words.

## 欺诈者几乎毫无底线可言。

<!--en-->
*FRAUDSTERS KNOW FEW LIMITS*

那些从盈余管理滑向彻底欺诈的公司，有时会不遗余力地掩盖其行径。它们可能会拉拢审计师成为共谋者，使其不再充当财务报表使用者的保护者。犯罪性虚假陈述的证据往往在事后才显现出来；即便是最精明的分析师，也要等到这些骗局无法维持、公司倒闭之后，才能确认某些最著名的欺诈行为。

<!--en-->
Companies that cross the line from earnings management to outright fraud sometimes go to great lengths to cover their tracks. This may include enlisting the auditors to be coconspirators against, rather than protectors of, the users of financial statements. The evidence of criminal misrepresentation often appears obvious after the fact, but not even the most skilled analysts definitively identified some of the most famous frauds until the schemes became unsustainable and the companies collapsed.

接下来的三个案例研究——安然、HealthSouth和帕玛拉特——都是警示性的教训。看似普通的激进会计处理方式，实际上可能隐藏着更为险恶的意图：可能根本没有真正的资产来支持其对债权人和股东所作出的承诺。在研究这些臭名昭著的欺诈案时，读者不仅要密切关注财务报表中的可疑项目，还要留意高级管理人员的行为——尤其是当其所宣称的利润真实性受到质疑时。

<!--en-->
The three following case studies, Enron, HealthSouth, and Parmalat, are cautionary tales. What appears to be a run-of-the-mill instance of aggressive reporting may prove to be something much more malevolent. It may turn out to be a case of almost no bona fide assets supporting the claims of creditors and shareholders. In studying these notorious frauds, readers should pay close attention not only to the suspicious financial statement items but also to the behavior of senior managers as the validity of their stated profits is challenged.

### 安然：媒体关注的焦点

<!--en-->
*ENRON: A MEDIA SENSATION*

2000年10月，《财富》杂志根据企业高管和证券分析师的评价，公布了全球最受推崇的公司名单。该商业杂志在介绍其中一家精英企业时写道：“没有哪家公司能比安然更生动地诠释创新的变革力量。”³ 在过去十年间，安然从一家传统能源管道运营商转变为新经济时代的交易巨头；通过创造全新的业务模式，其营收从2亿美元飙升至400亿美元。事实证明，安然的“创新”更多体现在其申报的盈利数字上。就在被列为全球25家最受推崇的公司不到一年后，安然于2001年12月2日申请破产。更深入审视其利润情况……

<!--en-->
In October 2000, *Fortune* published a list of the world's most admired companies, based on evaluations by executives and securities analysts. The business magazine wrote about one of these elite corporations, “No companyillustrates the transformative power of innovation more dramatically than Enron.”³ Over the preceding decade, *Fortune* continued, Enron had transformed itself from an Old Economy pipeline operator to a New Economy trading powerhouse and increased its revenues from $200 million to $40 billion by inventing entirely new businesses. As it turned out, Enron’s inventing had more to do with its reported earnings. The company filed for bankruptcy on December 2, 2001, only a little more than a year after being ranked among the 25 most admired companies in the world.
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

安然的轰然倒塌是一场备受瞩目的媒体事件。一年多时间里，报纸头条不断报道这家公司的会计做法——这类话题极少受到如此关注。此事催生了贝萨尼·麦克莱恩和彼得·埃尔金德所著的畅销书《房间里最聪明的人》，该书后被改编成由亚历克斯·吉布尼执导的电影。露西·普雷布尔创作的讽刺剧《安然》在伦敦大获成功，但在纽约仅上演三周便告停，给赞助商造成了360万美元的损失，进一步加剧了该公司带来的负面影响。⁴ 对投资者和贷款人而言，更重要的是：安然提高了财务报表分析师的门槛。该公司并非只是以常规比率分析就能察觉的方式滥用会计准则；其神秘的管理层将许多重要的盈利来源排除在资产负债表之外，并竭力恐吓那些抱怨信息披露不足的人。因此，一些投资组合经理和分析师早在严重虚假陈述曝光前就已对管理层失去信任。外界无法准确预测该公司的盈利情况，这更加重了他们的不安。2001年底公布的财务重述涉及从1997年开始的年度报告，但直到安然倒闭前几天，证券分析师才公开宣称该公司的财务报表不可信。

<!--en-->
Enron’s spectacular fall was an extraordinary media event. For more than a year, newspaper headlines dealt with a single company’s accounting practices, a subject rarely given such attention. The affair spawned a best-selling book, *The Smartest Guys in the Room*, by Bethany McLean and Peter Elkind, which was adapted into a film directed by Alex Gibney. Lucy Prebble’s satirical play, *Enron*, was a runaway hit in London, but the New York production closed after just three weeks, adding the backers’ $3.6 million to the collateral damage from the company’s sorry history.⁴
More important from the standpoint of investors and lenders, Enron raised the bar for financial statement analysts. The company did not merely take liberties with accounting standards in ways that standard ratio analysis would reveal. Instead, the secretive management kept many of the most important sources of reported earnings off the balance sheet and did its best to intimidate anyone who complained about inadequate disclosure. As a result, some portfolio managers and analysts came to mistrust management long before any serious misrepresentation came to light. Outsiders’ inability to model the company’s earnings added to their discomfort. Restatements announced in late 2001 covered annual reports beginning in 1997, but not until a few days before Enron’s collapse did security analysts openly proclaim that the company’s financial statements were unreliable.

### 公司背景

<!--en-->
*Company Background*

安然公司源于1979年休斯顿天然气公司与InterNorth的合并。InterNorth是成立于1932年、总部位于内布拉斯加州奥马哈的Northern Natural Gas的控股公司。HNG/InterNorth成立后不久，前任HNG首席执行官肯尼斯·莱出任CEO，并将公司更名为Enteron。然而在名片和信纸印好后，管理层发现新名称与希腊语中“肠子”一词极为相似，于是改为“Enron”。

<!--en-->
Enron was the product of the 1979 acquisition of Houston Natural Gas by InterNorth, the holding company for Northern Natural Gas, founded in Omaha, Nebraska, in 1932. Shortly after the formation of HNG/InterNorth, former HNG Chief Executive Officer Kenneth Lay became CEO and renamed the company Enteron. After business cards and stationery were printed, management learned that the new name closely resembled the Greek word for intestines, so Enron was substituted.

莱将安然的业务范围远远拓展出最初的天然气管道以及电力和天然气的生产与配送领域。他发展起庞大的交易业务，涉及石油运输、电力、钢铁、纸张、宽带、天气衍生品及废水处理等多种产品，还包括各类商品期货。1999年，公司推出了基于互联网的交易平台EnronOnline。总裁兼首席运营官杰弗里·斯基林将这一业务打造成美国领先的天然气和电力批发商，并接替莱担任CEO。欺诈行为能否被察觉？203

<!--en-->
Lay took Enron far beyond its original activities, natural gas pipelines and the generation and distribution of electricity and natural gas. He developed a vast trading business dealing in diverse products that included oil transportation, electric power, steel, paper, broadband, weather, andwastewater, as well as a variety of commodity futures. In 1999, the company launched an Internet-based trading business, EnronOnline. President and Chief Operating Officer Jeffrey Skilling built this operation into America's leading gas and electricity wholesaler and succeeded Lay as CEO.
Is Fraud Detectable?
203

安然借着能源市场放松管制的东风蓬勃发展。2000年，其营收翻了一番多，盈利增长25%，股价更是上涨了89%。

<!--en-->
Enron rode high on the trend of energy deregulation. In 2000, revenues more than doubled, earnings soared by 25 percent, and the company's share price rose by 89 percent.

然而，2001年一切开始分崩离析。8月，斯基林突然辞去首席执行官一职，迫使继续担任董事长的雷重新掌舵。雷称：“我可以坦诚地说，公司正处于有史以来最强劲的状态。”⁵ 高级管理层的意外变动是财务造假的典型预警信号；10月，首席财务官安德鲁·法斯托的离职再次预示着麻烦将至。

<!--en-->
In 2001, however, everything began to unravel. In August, Skilling suddenly stepped down as CEO, forcing Lay, who had continued as chairman, to take back the reins. Lay commented, "I can honestly say the company is in the strongest shape it's ever been in."⁵ Unexpected turnover in senior management is a classic warning sign of financial misrepresentation, and trouble was signaled again with the departure of Chief Financial Officer Andrew Fastow in October.

在担任安然公司高管的同时，法斯托还是LJM开曼群岛私人投资合伙企业的管理人。该企业从事衍生品交易，表面上是为管理安然公司的交易风险。股东们认为法斯托的双重身份存在利益冲突，并对有关LJM及相关合伙企业的披露信息含糊不清感到担忧。面对这些批评，安然公司终止了与这些合伙企业的合作关系。由此导致的期票减值使股东权益减少了12亿美元，但安然公司在截至2001年9月30日的季度财报中甚至未提及此事。

<!--en-->
At the same time that he was a senior executive of Enron, Fastow had been the managing member of LJM Cayman, a private investment partnership that engaged in derivatives transactions ostensibly designed to manage Enron's trading risk. Shareholders saw a conflict of interest in Fastow's dual role and worried about the vagueness of disclosure regarding LJM and related partnerships. In response to this criticism, Enron terminated its relationship with the partnerships. The associated write-down of a promissory note produced a $1.2 billion decline in shareholders' equity, which Enron did not even mention in its earnings release for the quarter ending September 30, 2001.

后来，当首席执行官雷在与分析师的电话会议中提及此次减值时，投资者对有关这些合伙企业的信息不透明感到震惊。

<!--en-->
When CEO Lay later alluded to the write-down in a conference call with analysts, investors became alarmed about the lack of clarity regarding the partnerships.

他们担心安然公司可能利用这些合伙企业来掩盖其核心交易业务中的亏损。感到困惑的不只是投资者。8月，当被问及法斯托复杂交易的细节时，雷回答说这些问题超出了他的理解范围。如今，似乎唯一能理解这些交易的人——斯基林和法斯托——已经离开了公司。随着美国证券交易委员会对安然公司的财务报告展开调查，投资者的焦虑情绪进一步加剧。

<!--en-->
They feared that Enron might have used them to hide losses in its core trading business. Investors were not alone in their confusion. In August, when asked about details of Fastow's complex transactions, Lay had replied that the questions were getting way over his head. Now, the two individuals who did appear to understand the deals—Skilling and Fastow—were gone from the company. Investor anxiety mounted as the Securities and Exchange Commission launched an investigation into Enron's financial reporting.

更不祥的是，这家本应盈利丰厚的公司正面临可能的现金流危机。安然公司动用了33亿美元的银行信贷额度，且其债务有可能被降级为投机级。事实上，安然公司的债券收益率已经与该类别的其他债券相当。一旦被降级为投机级，该公司可能被迫发行数千万股股票以偿还所担保的33亿美元贷款，从而通过**稀释效应**压低股价。评级下调还可能因导致其他交易商停止与安然公司合作而重创其交易业务。更深入地审视利润情况

<!--en-->
Ominously as well, the supposedly highly profitable company was facing a possible cash squeeze. Enron drew down a $3.3 billion bank line of credit and faced the possibility that its debt would be downgraded to speculative grade. Already, Enron's bonds were trading at yields comparable to others in that category. The company faced the problem that a fall to speculative grade might compel it to issue tens of millions of shares of stock to cover the $3.3 billion of loans it had guaranteed, driving down its share price through **dilution**. Downgrading could also cripple Enron's trading business by inducing other traders to cease doing business with it.
A CLOSER LOOK AT PROFITS

随着局势恶化，安然公司与Dynegy公司达成协议，后者将以每股9.80美元的价格用自身股票收购安然公司。

<!--en-->
As the situation deteriorated, Enron struck a deal to be acquired by Dynegy for stock of the rival energy trader worth $9.80 per Enron share.

一年前，安然公司的股价还高达83美元。这笔交易还包括Dynegy公司持股27%的雪佛龙德士古公司提供的现金注入，其前提是安然公司避免被降级为投机级。

<!--en-->
A year earlier, Enron had traded at $83. The transaction, which included a cash infusion by Dynegy's 27 percent owner, ChevronTexaco, hinged on Enron avoiding a downgrade to speculative grade.

1997年至2001年期间，安然公司盈利被向下修正5.91亿美元，这对其维持投资级评级十分不利。大部分调整源于将此前被视为独立实体的两家特殊目的合伙企业以及由法斯托管理的LJM合伙企业旗下子公司的业绩计入盈利。剩余的9200万美元调整则来自安然公司的审计师安达信公司曾建议但最终放弃的变更，因为该公司认为涉及金额微不足道。

<!--en-->
Enron's case for remaining investment grade was not helped by a $591 million downward restatement of earnings for the period 1997 through 2001. Most of the revision arose from including in earnings the results of two special purpose partnerships formerly treated as independent and of a subsidiary of the LJM partnership previously run by Fastow. The remainder, $92 million, consisted of changes that Enron's auditor, Arthur Andersen, had recommended but backed down on, accepting the company's argument that the amounts involved were immaterial.

安达信公司的一位发言人称此为“不幸的情况”。⁶ 这简直是轻描淡写。作为美国五大审计机构之一，安达信公司因销毁与安然审计相关的文件而被判妨碍司法罪，随后被迫退出会计行业。

<!--en-->
A spokesman for Arthur Andersen called it “an unfortunate situation.”⁶ This proved to be a massive understatement. The firm, one of the nation's five largest auditors, was forced out of the accounting business after being convicted of obstruction of justice for shredding documents related to the Enron audit.

安然公司最终承认自己负债过重。管理层试图重组现有债务、安排额外借款、获取股权注资，并通过出售海外资产来筹集资金。

<!--en-->
Enron at long last conceded that it was overly indebted. Management tried to restructure existing debt, arrange additional borrowings, obtain equity infusions, and raise cash by selling overseas assets.
